about: The children's sources rewritten for the site by Claude Opus: the BSB's facts and words, a child's words, standing alone, four choices, then checked by a second Opus call against the BSB; written by scripts/question_children_sources.py.

children-batch4:assu:1.question: Which book should we love and treasure more than any other book?
children-batch4:assu:1.why: Simpler words; added choices and a reference

children-batch4:assu:10.question: What does Genesis, the first book of the Bible, begin by telling us about?

children-batch4:assu:100.question: Through which son did God say Abraham's family would be counted?
children-batch4:assu:100.why: Made to match the verse's words about the promise

children-batch4:assu:1000.question: What happened to Naaman's skin after he washed in the Jordan?
children-batch4:assu:1000.answer: It became clean, like a little child's
children-batch4:assu:1000.why: Named Naaman; answer in BSB words

children-batch4:assu:1001.question: What did Naaman ask Elisha to accept from him?
children-batch4:assu:1001.why: Named Naaman; 'present' to 'gift' as in BSB

children-batch4:assu:1002.question: What did Elisha do when Naaman asked him to take a gift?

children-batch4:assu:1003.question: When Elisha would not take Naaman's gift, what did Elisha's servant Gehazi do?
children-batch4:assu:1003.answer: He ran after Naaman for gifts
wrong: He went to wash in the Jordan
He thanked Naaman and went home

children-batch4:assu:1004.question: How did Gehazi get silver and clothes from Naaman?
children-batch4:assu:1004.why: Named Gehazi and what he got; 'falsehood' to 'lie'

children-batch4:assu:1005.question: How was Gehazi punished for his lie?
children-batch4:assu:1005.answer: He got leprosy, a skin sickness
wrong: He was put in a dark prison
He lost his sight for good
He was sent to a far land

children-batch4:assu:1006.question: In King Hezekiah's time, who came and attacked the city of Samaria?
children-batch4:assu:1006.why: Named the king and city from the BSB verse; simpler words

children-batch4:assu:1007.question: How long did it take the Assyrians to capture the city of Samaria?
children-batch4:assu:1007.why: Named who and what; plainer words

children-batch4:assu:1008.question: King Hezekiah refused to serve which king?
children-batch4:assu:1008.why: Changed the answer to match the BSB verse, which says only 'the king of Assyria'; simpler words

children-batch4:assu:1009.question: What did Sennacherib, king of Assyria, do to the land of Judah?
children-batch4:assu:1009.answer: He attacked and captured its strong cities
children-batch4:assu:1009.why: Named Sennacherib; answer follows the BSB

children-batch4:assu:101.question: How old was Abraham when his son Isaac was born?

children-batch4:assu:1010.question: When God saved Jerusalem, how many Assyrian soldiers did the angel of the LORD strike down in one night?
children-batch4:assu:1010.why: Named who and whose army; told gently, as God saving His people

children-batch4:assu:1011.question: Who struck down the Assyrian army in one night?
children-batch4:assu:1011.why: Made it stand on its own; fixed the wording

children-batch4:assu:1012.question: What happened to King Sennacherib while he was worshiping his false god Nisroch?
wrong: He turned to worship the LORD
He fled to the land of Ararat
He went back to attack Jerusalem
children-batch4:assu:1012.why: Named Sennacherib and the place; told gently

children-batch4:assu:1013.question: Which king helped God's people go back to Jerusalem to build the house of the LORD?
children-batch4:assu:1013.why: Simpler words; said what the help was, following the BSB

children-batch4:assu:1014.question: What country was Cyrus king of?
children-batch4:assu:1014.why: Changed 'Of what country' to plainer words

children-batch4:assu:1015.question: Who moved the heart of King Cyrus to send out his message about building God's house?
children-batch4:assu:1015.why: Said what Cyrus did; 'the LORD' as the BSB has it

children-batch4:assu:1016.question: In which prophet's book does the LORD speak to Cyrus by name?
children-batch4:assu:1016.why: Made it stand on its own; left out the 'long before' claim, which the verse does not give

children-batch4:assu:1017.dropped: No Bible passage says how many years before Cyrus was born the words were spoken. The answer 'nearly two hundred years' is a date worked out by people.

children-batch4:assu:1018.question: When God's people came back to Jerusalem, what did they start to build?
children-batch4:assu:1018.why: Made it stand on its own; 'house of the LORD' as in the BSB

children-batch4:assu:1019.question: Along with Jeshua the priest, who led the people in building God's altar and house?
children-batch4:assu:1019.why: Made it stand on its own; added Jeshua, who is named with Zerubbabel in the verses

children-batch4:assu:102.question: Who was the brother of Isaac?

children-batch4:assu:1020.question: When the foundation of the house of the LORD was laid, what did all the people do?
children-batch4:assu:1020.answer: Gave a great shout of praise
children-batch4:assu:1020.why: Answer follows the BSB: a shout of praise; simpler words

children-batch4:assu:1021.question: When the enemies of Judah heard that the people were building the temple, what did they ask Zerubbabel?
wrong: To let them tear it down
To give them gold from it
children-batch4:assu:1021.why: Simpler words; named the enemies and the temple

children-batch4:assu:1022.question: What did Zerubbabel and the leaders of Israel say to the enemies who wanted to help build the temple?
children-batch4:assu:1022.answer: "You have no part with us in building"
wrong: "Come and help us build the temple"
"Go build a temple of your own"
children-batch4:assu:1022.fixed: The question did not say what the enemies wanted to help build. Verses 4:1-2 show it was the temple, so that is now named.

children-batch4:assu:1023.question: After Zerubbabel said no, what did the people of the land do to the builders of the temple?
children-batch4:assu:1023.answer: Tried to make them afraid to build
wrong: Went back to their homes quietly

children-batch4:assu:1024.question: How long did the enemies of Judah try to stop the building of the temple?
children-batch4:assu:1024.answer: From King Cyrus to King Darius
wrong: From King Saul to King David
From King Ahab to King Jehu

children-batch4:assu:1025.question: In what year of King Darius was the temple finished?

children-batch4:assu:1026.dropped: The verses don't say how many years the building took; 'about twenty years' comes from adding up dates outside the text

children-batch4:assu:1027.question: Which man did King Artaxerxes make governor of the land of Judah?
children-batch4:assu:1027.why: Ezra was never governor, so the question was reworded to what Nehemiah 5:14 says

children-batch4:assu:1028.question: What was Nehemiah's job for the king?

children-batch4:assu:1029.question: What news did Nehemiah hear about Jerusalem?
children-batch4:assu:1029.answer: Its wall was broken and gates burned
wrong: The city was full of gold and silver
A new king had been crowned there
The temple had fallen into the sea

children-batch4:assu:1030.question: What did Nehemiah do when he heard the sad news about Jerusalem?

children-batch4:assu:1031.question: What did Nehemiah ask the king to do?

children-batch4:assu:1032.question: Why did Nehemiah ask the king to send him to Jerusalem?
wrong: So he could become its king
So he could fight a war
So he could sell its land
children-batch4:assu:1032.why: Made it stand on its own

children-batch4:assu:1033.question: How did the workers who carried materials for Jerusalem's wall do their work?
children-batch4:assu:1033.answer: One hand worked, one held a weapon
wrong: They worked only at night in secret
They used a big machine from the king
They sat down and sang songs all day
children-batch4:assu:1033.fixed: The verses say only the workers who carried materials worked with one hand and held a weapon in the other. The builders worked with a sword strapped at their side. The question said this about all the workers.

children-batch4:assu:1034.question: Why did the builders of Jerusalem's wall keep weapons with them?
children-batch4:assu:1034.answer: Their enemies planned to attack them
wrong: The king told them to hunt animals
They were getting ready for a parade
They used the weapons to cut stones
children-batch4:assu:1034.why: Made it stand on its own; told gently; pointed to the verse that gives the reason

children-batch4:assu:1035.question: How long did it take to rebuild the wall of Jerusalem?

children-batch4:assu:1036.question: How did the enemies around Jerusalem feel when they heard the wall was finished?
children-batch4:assu:1036.why: Named the enemies and the wall; answer follows the BSB ('afraid and disheartened')

children-batch4:assu:1037.question: Who was Xerxes in the book of Esther?
wrong: A prophet who spoke for God
A priest who served in the temple
A fisherman who lived by the sea
children-batch4:assu:1037.why: Used the BSB name Xerxes; answer taken from the verse

children-batch4:assu:1038.question: Who was King Xerxes' queen at first?
children-batch4:assu:1038.why: Named King Xerxes and added 'at first' so the question stands alone

children-batch4:assu:1039.question: What happened to Queen Vashti when she would not obey King Xerxes?
children-batch4:assu:1039.answer: She could no longer be queen
wrong: She was given a new crown
She was sent to rule a city
children-batch4:assu:1039.why: Named Vashti and the king; used simpler words

children-batch4:assu:104.question: How did God test Abraham?
children-batch4:assu:104.answer: He told Abraham to offer up Isaac
wrong: He told Abraham to build an ark
He told Abraham to return to Ur
He told Abraham to count the sand
children-batch4:assu:104.why: 'Tempt' changed to 'test' as in BSB; told gently

children-batch4:assu:1040.question: Who was made queen in place of Vashti?
children-batch4:assu:1040.why: Changed 'in her stead' to 'in place of Vashti'; reference changed to 2:17, which holds the answer

children-batch4:assu:1041.question: What people did Esther belong to?

children-batch4:assu:1042.question: Who took care of Esther and raised her as his own daughter?
children-batch4:assu:1042.why: Made the wording simpler and named Esther

children-batch4:assu:1043.question: What good thing did Mordecai do for King Xerxes?
children-batch4:assu:1043.answer: He told of a plot against the king
wrong: He built the king a new palace
He won a big battle for the king
He brought the king a lot of gold
children-batch4:assu:1043.why: Made the wording simpler; told the plot gently

children-batch4:assu:1044.question: Whom did King Xerxes honor and put above all his princes?
children-batch4:assu:1044.why: Used the name Xerxes and simpler words

children-batch4:assu:1045.question: What did the king's servants at the gate do for Haman?

children-batch4:assu:1046.question: Who would not bow down to Haman?
children-batch4:assu:1046.why: Named Haman; 'do reverence' changed to 'bow down'

children-batch4:assu:1047.question: How did Haman feel when Mordecai would not bow down to him?
children-batch4:assu:1047.why: Named Haman and Mordecai so the question stands alone

children-batch4:assu:1048.question: Instead of only punishing Mordecai, what did Haman want to do?
children-batch4:assu:1048.why: Named Haman; made the question stand alone

children-batch4:assu:1049.question: What order did Haman send out in King Xerxes' name?
wrong: To set all the Jews free
children-batch4:assu:1049.why: Named Haman and the king; matched the order in the verses

children-batch4:assu:105.question: What did Abraham do the morning after God told him to offer Isaac?
children-batch4:assu:105.answer: He got up early and set out
wrong: He hid from God all day long
He stayed home and rested in bed
He ran away down to Egypt
children-batch4:assu:105.why: Made it stand alone with four clear choices
children-batch4:assu:105.fixed: "After God spoke to him" doesn't say which time God spoke, and God spoke to Abraham many times. The question should say it was when God told him to offer Isaac.

children-batch4:assu:1050.question: What did Mordecai do when he learned about Haman's order?
children-batch4:assu:1050.answer: He tore his clothes and cried loudly
wrong: He held a big party with friends
He ran away to hide in the hills
He bowed down low to Haman
children-batch4:assu:1050.why: Made the question stand alone; 'rent' changed to 'tore'

children-batch4:assu:1051.question: What did Mordecai ask Queen Esther to do?
children-batch4:assu:1051.answer: Beg the king to save her people
wrong: Leave the city and go hide
Write a kind letter to Haman
Make a big feast for the Jews
children-batch4:assu:1051.why: Named Mordecai and Esther; plain words

children-batch4:assu:1052.question: For how many days did Esther ask the Jews to fast for her?

children-batch4:assu:1053.question: What did King Xerxes hold out to Esther when she came to him?
children-batch4:assu:1053.why: Named the king and Esther; BSB 'gold scepter'

children-batch4:assu:1054.question: What did Esther first ask King Xerxes to do?
children-batch4:assu:1054.answer: Come with Haman to her banquet
wrong: Send Haman far away from Susa
Give her a brand new palace
children-batch4:assu:1054.why: Named Esther and the king; simpler words

children-batch4:assu:1055.question: At her first banquet, what did Esther ask the king and Haman to do?
wrong: Give her a bag of gold
Go out hunting with her tomorrow
children-batch4:assu:1055.why: Made it stand alone; plain words

children-batch4:assu:1056.question: How did Haman feel when he left Esther's first banquet?

children-batch4:assu:1057.question: Who made Haman very angry at the king's gate?
children-batch4:assu:1057.why: Made it stand alone; 'indignation' made plain

children-batch4:assu:1058.question: When Haman went home, whom did he call together?
children-batch4:assu:1058.answer: His friends and his wife Zeresh

children-batch4:assu:1059.question: What did Haman boast about to his wife and friends?
wrong: His trip to a far land
children-batch4:assu:1059.why: Named Haman; answer follows BSB details

children-batch4:assu:106.question: As Abraham and Isaac walked to the place, what did Isaac ask his father?
children-batch4:assu:106.answer: Where is the lamb for the offering?
wrong: Where is the water for us to drink?
When will we go back home again?
Where is my mother Sarah today?
children-batch4:assu:106.why: Named Abraham and Isaac; BSB wording; added choices

children-batch4:assu:1060.question: Why was Haman still not happy, even with all his riches?
children-batch4:assu:1060.answer: Mordecai was still sitting at the king's gate
wrong: The king was angry with him
He had lost all his money
children-batch4:assu:1060.why: Plain words; answer follows BSB verse

children-batch4:assu:1061.question: What did Haman's wife and friends tell him to do about Mordecai?
children-batch4:assu:1061.answer: Build a gallows to hang Mordecai on
wrong: Make friends with Mordecai at once
children-batch4:assu:1061.why: Named Haman and his advisers; told gently

children-batch4:assu:1062.question: Why did King Xerxes want to honor Mordecai?
wrong: He had won a great battle
He had built the king's palace
He found the king's lost ring

children-batch4:assu:1063.question: How did Haman have to honor Mordecai?
children-batch4:assu:1063.answer: Lead him through town on the king's horse
wrong: Give Mordecai a big house of his own
Bow down to him at a great feast
Give him a big bag of gold coins

children-batch4:assu:1064.question: What did Haman call out as he led Mordecai through the city?
children-batch4:assu:1064.answer: "This is done for the man the king wants to honor!"
wrong: "Everyone must bow down to Haman, the king's best friend!"
"All the people must send Mordecai the Jew away today!"
"The king will give a great feast for everyone tonight!"
children-batch4:assu:1064.why: Made it stand alone; BSB wording

children-batch4:assu:1065.question: At the second banquet, what did Esther ask the king for?
children-batch4:assu:1065.answer: To save her and her people
wrong: A bigger palace to live in
All of Haman's riches and gold
A new golden crown for herself
children-batch4:assu:1065.why: Named the second banquet; plain words

children-batch4:assu:1066.question: Queen Esther told King Xerxes that she and her people had been sold. What had they been sold to?
children-batch4:assu:1066.why: Named Esther and the king; plain words; gentle answer

children-batch4:assu:1067.question: When Esther told about the plan against her people, what did King Xerxes ask?
children-batch4:assu:1067.answer: "Who is this, and where is he?"
children-batch4:assu:1067.why: Named the king; BSB wording of his question

children-batch4:assu:1068.question: Whom did Queen Esther name as the enemy of her people?
children-batch4:assu:1068.why: Made it stand alone; BSB wording

children-batch4:assu:1069.question: What did King Xerxes order to be done with wicked Haman?
children-batch4:assu:1069.answer: Hang him on his own gallows
wrong: Make him a prince of the land
Send him home to his wife
Give him a gift of gold
children-batch4:assu:1069.why: Named the king and Haman; told gently

children-batch4:assu:107.question: When Isaac asked where the lamb was, what did Abraham answer?
children-batch4:assu:107.answer: God Himself will provide the lamb.
wrong: We will buy a lamb in the town.
The servants will bring a lamb.
We do not need a lamb today.
children-batch4:assu:107.why: Made it stand alone; BSB wording

children-batch4:assu:1070.question: Whom had Haman built the gallows at his house for?
children-batch4:assu:1070.why: Made it stand alone; asked about whom the gallows was built for

children-batch4:assu:1071.question: Whom did Queen Esther put in charge of everything Haman had owned?
children-batch4:assu:1071.why: Plain words; named Esther as in the BSB

children-batch4:assu:1072.question: Why did Queen Esther go to King Xerxes again, crying at his feet?
children-batch4:assu:1072.answer: To stop Haman's evil plan against the Jews
wrong: To ask for a new crown
To ask for a bigger palace

children-batch4:assu:1073.question: What did King Xerxes let the Jews do in every city?
children-batch4:assu:1073.why: Named the king; plain words, gentle

children-batch4:assu:1074.question: What did the Jews do on the day their enemies planned to harm them?
children-batch4:assu:1074.answer: Gathered in their cities against those who wanted to harm them

children-batch4:assu:1075.question: On the day the enemies of the Jews hoped to beat them, who won?
children-batch4:assu:1075.why: Told gently, not focused on bloodshed; stands alone
children-batch4:assu:1075.fixed: The question never says who 'them' is. It now names the Jews, and the answer still fits Esther 9:1-5.

children-batch4:assu:1076.question: After the Jews were saved and had rested, what kind of day did they make it?
children-batch4:assu:1076.answer: A day of feasting and joy

children-batch4:assu:1078.question: What kind of man was Job?

children-batch4:assu:1079.question: What does the Bible say about how great Job was?
children-batch4:assu:1079.answer: He was the greatest in the East
wrong: He was the king of Egypt
He was the poorest man in Uz
He was the leader of an army

children-batch4:assu:108.question: When Abraham and Isaac reached the place, what did Abraham build?
children-batch4:assu:108.why: Named Abraham and Isaac; added choices

children-batch4:assu:1080.question: How many sheep did Job own?
children-batch4:assu:1080.why: Asked about one number so the choices are clear

children-batch4:assu:1081.question: What did Job do for his children after their days of feasting?
wrong: Built each of them a new house
Gave each of them new camels
Sent them far away on a trip
children-batch4:assu:1081.why: Named Job; 'sons' to 'children' as in the BSB; simpler words

children-batch4:assu:1082.question: Why did Job offer burnt offerings for his children?
children-batch4:assu:1082.answer: He thought they might have sinned
wrong: He wanted rain for his fields
He was going on a long trip
children-batch4:assu:1082.why: Named Job and what the question is about

children-batch4:assu:1083.question: One day, when the sons of God came before the LORD, who came with them?

children-batch4:assu:1084.question: What did the LORD say to Satan about Job?
children-batch4:assu:1084.answer: No one on earth is like him
wrong: He is too lazy and too proud
He has far too many camels
He should leave his own land
children-batch4:assu:1084.why: Simpler wording; answer in BSB words

children-batch4:assu:1085.question: What did Satan say Job would do if he lost everything he had?
children-batch4:assu:1085.why: Simpler wording; 'curse You to Your face' as in the BSB

children-batch4:assu:1086.question: When the LORD let Satan test Job, what did He put in Satan's hands?
children-batch4:assu:1086.why: Made it say what was put in Satan's hands and what was kept back, as the BSB says

children-batch4:assu:1087.question: After Job lost his children and everything he had, what did Job say about the LORD?
children-batch4:assu:1087.answer: Blessed be the name of the LORD
wrong: The LORD has forgotten all about me
I will never ever pray again
My friends will come and help me
children-batch4:assu:1087.why: Named Job; KJV 'hath' taken out; answer shortened to the BSB words

children-batch4:assu:1088.question: The second time the LORD let Satan test Job, what did the LORD say Satan must do?
children-batch4:assu:1088.why: Simpler wording; named Job; said which time

children-batch4:assu:1089.question: What did Satan make Job sick with?
children-batch4:assu:1089.why: 'Smite' changed to plain words; BSB 'terrible boils'

children-batch4:assu:109.question: After Abraham built the altar, what did he do with Isaac?
children-batch4:assu:109.answer: He tied Isaac and laid him on the altar.
wrong: He sent Isaac home to Sarah.
He sent Isaac to look for a lamb.
He hid Isaac in a cave.
children-batch4:assu:109.why: Named Abraham; told gently without the knife

children-batch4:assu:1090.question: Who came to visit Job when they heard about his troubles?

children-batch4:assu:1091.question: What were the names of Job's three friends?
children-batch4:assu:1091.why: Named who the question is about

children-batch4:assu:1092.question: Why did Job's three friends come to see him?
wrong: To take him to the city
children-batch4:assu:1092.why: Made it a whole question; answer as the BSB says

children-batch4:assu:1093.question: What did Job's friends do when they first saw him?
children-batch4:assu:1093.why: Named Job's friends; answer in BSB words

children-batch4:assu:1094.question: How long did Job's friends sit with him without saying a word?

children-batch4:assu:1095.question: Why did Job's friends not say a word to him?
children-batch4:assu:1095.answer: They saw how much he was suffering
wrong: The king told them to be quiet
children-batch4:assu:1095.why: Made it a whole question; answer from the BSB

children-batch4:assu:1096.question: After his friends sat with him for seven days, what did Job do?
children-batch4:assu:1096.answer: He cursed the day he was born.
wrong: He asked his friends to go home.
He went out to find his sheep.
children-batch4:assu:1096.why: Named Job and the friends; matched BSB 'day of his birth'.

children-batch4:assu:1097.question: Who answered Job's first speech to his friends?

children-batch4:assu:1098.question: When Eliphaz finished speaking, who replied to him?

children-batch4:assu:1099.question: What did Job say was lined up against him?
children-batch4:assu:1099.why: Named Job; simpler words for 'set in array'.

children-batch4:assu:11.question: Who created the heavens and the earth?

children-batch4:assu:110.question: What happened to Isaac on the altar?
children-batch4:assu:110.answer: He was not harmed at all.
wrong: He ran away into the hills.
He fell into a deep sleep.
He was carried off by a lion.
children-batch4:assu:110.why: Yes-or-no made into four choices; told gently

children-batch4:assu:1100.question: What did Job ask God when he was suffering?
children-batch4:assu:1100.answer: Why have You made me Your target?
wrong: Why did You give me so many camels?
Why did You make the sun so hot?
Why did You send my friends away?
children-batch4:assu:1100.why: BSB says 'If I have sinned', not a confession; asked instead what Job asked God.

children-batch4:assu:1101.question: What did Job call his three friends?

children-batch4:assu:1102.dropped: No verse says Job spoke nine times; the number comes from counting speeches, which people count differently.

children-batch4:assu:1103.question: After Job's last speech, what did his three friends do?
wrong: They built him a new house.
children-batch4:assu:1103.why: 'Ninth speech' rests on counting; asked what the friends did, from Job 32:1.

children-batch4:assu:1104.question: Why was Elihu angry with Job's three friends?
children-batch4:assu:1104.answer: They blamed Job but could not prove him wrong.
wrong: They had eaten up all of Elihu's food.
They had come to visit Job much too late.
They had spoken much too quietly to Job.
children-batch4:assu:1104.why: Made it stand alone and matched BSB 32:3.

children-batch4:assu:1105.question: Who spoke after Job's three friends stopped answering him?
children-batch4:assu:1105.why: Made it stand alone without the speech count.

children-batch4:assu:1106.question: After Elihu finished speaking, who answered Job?
children-batch4:assu:1106.why: Made it stand alone; BSB 'the LORD'.

children-batch4:assu:1107.question: Out of what did the LORD answer Job?

children-batch4:assu:1108.question: What did Job say about himself when the LORD spoke to him?
children-batch4:assu:1108.answer: That he was small and could not answer God
wrong: That he was the wisest man in the world
That he knew much more than God did
That he had never been wrong even once
children-batch4:assu:1108.why: Changed to match BSB 'insignificant', in simple words.

children-batch4:assu:1109.question: After speaking to Job, whom did the LORD speak to next?

children-batch4:assu:1330.question: Jonah cared about the plant. What did the LORD say He should care about?
wrong: The great fish in the sea
children-batch4:assu:1330.why: Asked about the main point of God's words; BSB wording

children-batch4:assu:1331.question: How many people in Nineveh could not tell their right hand from their left?

children-batch4:assu:1332.question: What town did Micah say God's promised Ruler over Israel would come from?

children-batch4:assu:1333.question: Where was Jesus born, just as Micah had said?
children-batch4:assu:1333.why: Yes/no question made into four choices

children-batch4:assu:1334.question: Which city was the prophet Nahum's message against?
children-batch4:assu:1334.why: Asked what the verse says: the message was against Nineveh

children-batch4:assu:1335.dropped: The Bible never says which river Nineveh stood on

children-batch4:assu:1336.question: Which prophet said God would make the city of Nineveh as dry as a desert?
children-batch4:assu:1336.why: Named Nineveh and the detail from the verses so the question stands alone

children-batch4:assu:1337.question: How did the LORD tell Habakkuk to write down his vision?
children-batch4:assu:1337.answer: Clearly on tablets, so a messenger could run with it
wrong: In secret, so no one could read it
In the sand, so the wind would wipe it away
On a leaf, so it would blow away
children-batch4:assu:1337.why: Changed to the BSB wording: written clearly on tablets so a herald could run with it

children-batch4:assu:1338.question: In the book of Haggai, what did the LORD say He would fill His house with?
children-batch4:assu:1338.why: The BSB does not use the name 'Desire of all nations', so the question now asks what the verse does say

children-batch4:assu:1339.question: In the book of Zechariah, what name is given to the promised man who would build the temple of the LORD?
children-batch4:assu:1339.why: Said who 'he' is and named Zechariah, so the question stands alone

children-batch4:assu:134.question: After Abraham's servant told why he had come, what did Laban and Bethuel say?
children-batch4:assu:134.why: Replaced King James wording with the BSB words

children-batch4:assu:1340.question: Which two other prophets also called the promised King "the Branch"?
children-batch4:assu:1340.why: Said what 'the same name' is, so the question stands alone

children-batch4:assu:1341.question: How does Zechariah describe the King who comes to Jerusalem?
children-batch4:assu:1341.answer: Humble and riding on a donkey
wrong: Proud and riding on a war horse
Angry and riding in a chariot
Rich and carried on a golden chair
children-batch4:assu:1341.why: Used the BSB words and simpler wording

children-batch4:assu:1342.question: In the book of Malachi, God promised to send Elijah the prophet. Whose hearts would Elijah turn to their children?
children-batch4:assu:1342.why: Kept; added choices and a reference
children-batch4:assu:1342.fixed: The verses do not say that Malachi is the last book of the Old Testament. That comes from the order of books in our Bibles, not from the verse. The new question asks about what Malachi 4:6 actually says.

children-batch4:assu:1343.question: Malachi said God would send Elijah the prophet. Who did Jesus say this "Elijah" was?
children-batch4:assu:1343.why: The verse names Elijah, so Jesus' words naming John were added to back the answer

children-batch4:assu:1344.question: What name did Malachi use for the prophet God would send before the great Day of the LORD?

children-batch4:assu:1345.question: What did Malachi say God's messenger would do?
children-batch4:assu:1345.answer: Prepare the way before the LORD
wrong: Build a new temple for God
Lead a great army into battle
Rule as the king of Israel
children-batch4:assu:1345.why: Named the messenger and used the BSB wording

children-batch4:assu:1346.question: In the book of Malachi, what did the people who feared the LORD do?
wrong: They stopped talking to each other

children-batch4:assu:1347.question: When the people who feared the LORD spoke with one another, what did the LORD do?
children-batch4:assu:1347.why: Made the question stand alone and replaced the King James wording

children-batch4:assu:1348.question: What was written before the LORD about the people who feared Him?
children-batch4:assu:1348.why: Made the question stand alone and used the BSB's 'scroll'

children-batch4:assu:1349.question: What did the LORD promise about the people who feared Him?
children-batch4:assu:1349.answer: They would be His treasured people
wrong: They would be forgotten and left alone
They would be sent very far away
They would be made kings of Egypt
children-batch4:assu:1349.why: Made the question stand alone and used the BSB wording

children-batch4:assu:135.question: When Rebekah was asked if she would go with Abraham's servant, what did she say?
children-batch4:assu:135.why: Made it stand alone by saying what Rebekah was asked

children-batch4:assu:1350.question: In the book of Malachi, the LORD said His people would again see the difference between which two groups?
children-batch4:assu:1350.answer: Those who serve God and those who do not
children-batch4:assu:1350.why: Replaced the King James wording and named the book
children-batch4:assu:1350.fixed: The verse says 'you' (the people the LORD is speaking to), not 'everyone', so 'everyone' adds something. The question was also worded awkwardly for a child.

children-batch4:assu:1351.dropped: No passage of the Bible gives the time between the end of the Old Testament and Jesus' birth; that comes from history books.

children-batch4:assu:1352.question: Who came into the world to save sinners?
children-batch4:assu:1352.why: Made it a choice question; used 'Christ Jesus' as the BSB has it.

children-batch4:assu:1353.question: Why was Mary's baby to be named Jesus?
children-batch4:assu:1353.answer: He would save His people from their sins
wrong: He would be a great builder of houses
He would be born in a king's palace
He would be a strong soldier in battle
children-batch4:assu:1353.why: The verse gives the reason for the name, not a word meaning 'Saviour', so I asked why Jesus got His name.

children-batch4:assu:1354.question: In what land is Bethlehem, the town where Jesus was born?
children-batch4:assu:1354.why: Said who and what it is about; 'country' made 'land'.

children-batch4:assu:1355.dropped: No verse given or elsewhere in the Bible plainly says Judea is in the south of Canaan; this is a map fact.

children-batch4:assu:1356.question: Who was the husband of Mary, the mother of Jesus?
children-batch4:assu:1356.why: Changed 'reputed father' to plain words that match the verse: Joseph, Mary's husband.

children-batch4:assu:1357.question: Who was the mother of Jesus?
children-batch4:assu:1357.why: Named Jesus so the question stands on its own.

children-batch4:assu:1358.question: Where did Mary lay baby Jesus when He was born?
wrong: In a basket on a river
children-batch4:assu:1358.why: Named Jesus and Mary; used plain words.

children-batch4:assu:1359.question: Why was baby Jesus laid in a manger?
children-batch4:assu:1359.answer: There was no room in the inn
wrong: The inn was on fire that night
Mary wanted Him close to the animals
The shepherds asked Mary to do it
children-batch4:assu:1359.why: Named baby Jesus; answer follows the BSB ('them').

children-batch4:assu:136.question: What happened to Rebekah after she went with Abraham's servant?
wrong: She went back home to Laban.
children-batch4:assu:136.why: Named Rebekah and the story so the question makes sense alone; simpler words

children-batch4:assu:1360.why: Made it plain who and where, from the verse.

children-batch4:assu:1364.why: Named the shepherds; 'sore afraid' made 'very afraid', as in the BSB 'terrified'.

children-batch4:assu:1365.question: What did the angel say to the shepherds?
children-batch4:assu:1365.answer: Do not be afraid! I bring good news
wrong: Go home quickly and hide your sheep
Run away! The king is coming for you
Be quiet and go back to sleep now
children-batch4:assu:1365.why: Named the angel and the shepherds; answer put in BSB words.

children-batch4:assu:1366.question: Who did the angel tell the shepherds had been born?
children-batch4:assu:1366.why: Named the angel and shepherds; BSB wording

children-batch4:assu:1367.question: How did the angel say the shepherds would find the baby?
children-batch4:assu:1367.answer: Wrapped in cloths, lying in a manger
wrong: Dressed in gold, lying in a palace
children-batch4:assu:1367.why: Named who and what; BSB wording

children-batch4:assu:1368.question: Who suddenly appeared with the angel who spoke to the shepherds?

children-batch4:assu:1369.question: What were the many angels doing when they appeared to the shepherds?

children-batch4:assu:137.question: Who did Abraham leave everything he owned to?
children-batch4:assu:137.why: Removed KJV 'unto'; matched BSB 'everything he owned'

children-batch4:assu:1370.question: What did the crowd of angels say as they praised God?

children-batch4:assu:1371.question: When the angels had gone into heaven, what did the shepherds say to one another?
children-batch4:assu:1371.answer: "Let us go to Bethlehem and see"
wrong: "Let us stay here with our sheep"

children-batch4:assu:1372.question: What did the shepherds do after they had seen baby Jesus?

children-batch4:assu:1373.question: How did the people feel when they heard what the shepherds said?

children-batch4:assu:1377.answer: He held Jesus and blessed God
wrong: He sent them out of the temple
He ran to tell King Herod
He gave Jesus a gift of gold

children-batch4:assu:1378.question: What did Simeon say to God as he held baby Jesus?

children-batch4:assu:1384.answer: Where the Christ was to be born
wrong: What the baby's name would be
When the star would go away

children-batch4:assu:1385.question: Where did the chief priests and scribes say the Christ would be born?

children-batch4:assu:139.why: Named Abraham so it stands alone

children-batch4:assu:1390.answer: So he could worship Him too
wrong: So he could send Him a crown
So he could build Him a house
So he could give Him a horse

children-batch4:assu:1391.answer: No, he wanted to harm Him
wrong: Yes, he wanted to bring gifts

children-batch4:assu:1391.why: Yes-or-no made four choices; answer from Matt 2:13 rather than 'probably'

children-batch4:assu:1393.answer: The star went ahead of them

children-batch4:assu:1394.why: Named the Magi; BSB wording, no KJV

children-batch4:assu:1395.answer: The Child with His mother Mary

children-batch4:assu:1396.answer: They fell down and worshiped Him

They went back to tell Herod

children-batch4:assu:1398.why: Yes-or-no made four choices; named the Magi

children-batch4:assu:1399.answer: They were warned in a dream

There was no food in Bethlehem
children-batch4:assu:1402.why: Made it stand alone; told gently

children-batch4:assu:1403.answer: He took them to Egypt by night

He sent Jesus away with the Magi

children-batch4:assu:1405.why: Made it stand alone; 'town' as in BSB

children-batch4:assu:1406.why: 'Southern part' not in Scripture; asked the land the Bible names

children-batch4:assu:1407.why: Made it stand alone; BSB wording

children-batch4:assu:141.why: Added that they were twins, as the verses say; added reference

children-batch4:assu:1410.why: Named Jesus' parents; added Passover from the verse

children-batch4:assu:1411.answer: For the Feast of the Passover
children-batch4:assu:1411.why: Named the people and place; BSB feast name

children-batch4:assu:1412.question: How old was Jesus on the trip to the Feast when He stayed behind in Jerusalem?

children-batch4:assu:1413.question: When Jesus' family was going home from the Feast, who stayed behind in Jerusalem?

children-batch4:assu:1414.question: What did Jesus' parents know about Him staying behind in Jerusalem?
children-batch4:assu:1414.answer: They did not know He stayed

children-batch4:assu:1415.answer: With the group traveling with them

children-batch4:assu:1417.question: Among whom did Jesus' parents first look for Him?

children-batch4:assu:1419.question: After how many days did Jesus' parents find Him?

children-batch4:assu:142.why: Named Isaac's sons so it stands alone

children-batch4:assu:1423.question: What was the boy Jesus doing with the teachers in the temple?

children-batch4:assu:1424.question: How did people feel when they heard the boy Jesus in the temple?

children-batch4:assu:1425.question: What amazed the people who heard the boy Jesus in the temple?

children-batch4:assu:1426.question: What did Mary say when she and Joseph found Jesus in the temple?
children-batch4:assu:1426.answer: "Child, why have You done this to us?"

"Child, will You sing a song for us?"

children-batch4:assu:1427.question: How did Mary say she and Joseph had been looking for Jesus?

children-batch4:assu:1428.answer: "Did you not know that I had to be in My Father's house?"
wrong: "Did you not know that I was hungry and tired?"
"Did you not know that I wanted to go fishing?"
"Did you not know that I was lost in the city?"
children-batch4:assu:1428.why: Named Jesus and parents; BSB wording

children-batch4:assu:1429.answer: Went home to Nazareth and obeyed them
wrong: Stayed in Jerusalem all by Himself

Sailed across the sea to Rome

children-batch4:assu:1431.why: Made it stand alone; simple words

children-batch4:assu:1436.answer: Jerusalem, Judea and around the Jordan
wrong: Rome, Greece and the land of Egypt
Only from one small house nearby
Babylon, Persia and the land of Assyria

children-batch4:assu:1437.question: What happened when people came to John the Baptist at the Jordan River?
children-batch4:assu:1437.answer: They confessed their sins and were baptized
wrong: They built him a big house
They gave him a new coat
children-batch4:assu:1437.why: Made it stand alone; BSB wording

children-batch4:assu:1438.dropped: Geography fact; no Bible passage says the Jordan comes from Mount Hermon's springs and snows

children-batch4:assu:1439.question: When Israel crossed the Jordan River, the water was flowing toward which sea?

children-batch4:assu:144.question: How did Jacob get the blessing that Isaac meant for Esau?

By giving Isaac a flock of sheep

children-batch4:assu:1448.question: What was heard after the Spirit came down on Jesus?
children-batch4:assu:1448.why: Named the moment so it stands alone.

children-batch4:assu:1450.why: Named the time after His baptism.

children-batch4:assu:1454.question: What did the tempter tell Jesus to do with the stones?

wrong: They took Him back to Pilate
children-batch4:assu:1798.why: Made it stand alone; told gently

children-batch4:assu:1799.question: How many soldiers crucified Jesus and shared His clothes?
children-batch4:assu:1799.why: Asked as how many soldiers, which the verse shows by the four parts of His clothes

children-batch4:assu:18.question: What did God make on the second day?
children-batch4:assu:18.fixed: 'Expanse' is a hard word for a young child. Genesis 1:8 says God called the expanse 'sky', so the answer now says the sky.

children-batch4:assu:180.question: How many years did Isaac live?

children-batch4:assu:1800.question: What made the marks in Jesus' hands when He was on the cross?
children-batch4:assu:1800.why: Made it stand alone; short answer from the nail marks in the verses
children-batch4:assu:1800.fixed: John 20:25 speaks of nail marks in Jesus' hands. Luke 24:39 shows His hands and feet but does not say His feet were nailed. So the question should ask only about His hands.

children-batch4:assu:1801.question: What did Jesus pray for the people who hurt Him on the cross?
children-batch4:assu:1801.why: Named Jesus, simpler words, BSB wording of the prayer

children-batch4:assu:1802.question: What did the sign on Jesus' cross say?
children-batch4:assu:1802.answer: Jesus of Nazareth, the King of the Jews
wrong: Jesus, the son of Joseph the carpenter
Jesus, a robber from the land of Galilee
Jesus of Nazareth, the teacher of Israel

children-batch4:assu:1803.question: What did the chief priests and scribes say to make fun of Jesus on the cross?
children-batch4:assu:1803.answer: He saved others, but He cannot save Himself!
wrong: He never helped a single person at all!
He is a good and very wise teacher!
He should go back home to Nazareth now!
children-batch4:assu:1803.why: Dropped elders (not in Mark 15:31); named Jesus; BSB wording

children-batch4:assu:1804.question: Who were put on crosses next to Jesus?

children-batch4:assu:1805.question: What did one of the criminals on a cross beside Jesus do?
children-batch4:assu:1805.answer: He said mean, mocking things to Jesus
wrong: He prayed to God for Jesus
He sang a song to Jesus
He stayed quiet the whole time
children-batch4:assu:1805.why: Named who it is about; 'railed' put in plain words

children-batch4:assu:1806.question: One criminal on a cross beside Jesus said that Jesus had done nothing wrong. What did that man ask Jesus?
children-batch4:assu:1806.answer: Jesus, remember me when You come into Your kingdom!
wrong: Jesus, please get me down from this cross!
Jesus, please give me some cold water!
Jesus, please make the soldiers go away!
children-batch4:assu:1806.why: Named who it is about; BSB wording instead of King James
children-batch4:assu:1806.fixed: 'The other criminal' only makes sense if you already know about the first one. The question should say which criminal it means: the one who said Jesus had done nothing wrong.

children-batch4:assu:1807.question: What did Jesus tell the criminal who asked Jesus to remember him?
children-batch4:assu:1807.answer: Today you will be with Me in Paradise.
wrong: You will go back home tomorrow morning.
I am sorry, but I cannot help you.
You must wait a hundred long years.
children-batch4:assu:1807.why: Made it stand alone; BSB wording

children-batch4:assu:1808.question: What did the soldiers do with Jesus' clothes?
children-batch4:assu:1808.answer: Divided them up by casting lots
wrong: Burned them all in a fire
Gave them back to His mother
Buried them with Him in the tomb
children-batch4:assu:1808.why: 'Raiment' to 'clothes'; dropped coat detail not in the verse

children-batch4:assu:1809.question: How long was it dark over all the land while Jesus was on the cross?
children-batch4:assu:1809.why: Added who it is about; sixth to ninth hour is three hours

children-batch4:assu:181.question: Who buried Isaac when he died?
wrong: His wife Rebekah and her nurse

children-batch4:assu:1810.question: When Jesus was thirsty on the cross, what did they give Him to drink?

children-batch4:assu:1811.question: What did Jesus say after He drank the sour wine on the cross?

children-batch4:assu:1812.question: When Jesus said, "It is finished," what had He finished?
children-batch4:assu:1812.answer: His work to save us from our sins
wrong: Building a new house for His mother
His long walking trip to Egypt and back
Writing a whole book of the Bible
children-batch4:assu:1812.why: Made it stand alone; 'redemption' put simply; reference from Hebrews
children-batch4:assu:1812.fixed: The answer is right as catechism teaching from Hebrews 10:12-14. But the words 'It is finished' come from John 19:30, so that verse belongs in the reference too.

children-batch4:assu:1813.question: What happened to Jesus after He called out in a loud voice on the cross?
children-batch4:assu:1813.answer: He breathed His last and died
wrong: He fell asleep for a while
He climbed down from the cross
He walked away from the soldiers
children-batch4:assu:1813.why: Named Jesus; told gently in BSB words, no 'ghost'

children-batch4:assu:1814.question: What happened at the temple and on the earth when Jesus died?
children-batch4:assu:1814.answer: The temple veil tore and the earth shook
wrong: Snow fell down and the river froze
A big rainbow shone over the temple
The temple caught on fire and burned
children-batch4:assu:1814.why: Made it stand alone; BSB wording

children-batch4:assu:1815.question: When the centurion (an army officer) saw the earthquake, what did he say about Jesus?
children-batch4:assu:1815.answer: Truly this was the Son of God.
wrong: Truly this was a bad robber.
Truly this was a Roman soldier.
Truly this was the prophet Elijah.

children-batch4:assu:1816.question: About what hour did Jesus cry out in a loud voice on the cross, just before He died?
children-batch4:assu:1816.why: Used the BSB 'ninth hour' instead of three o'clock, said it was the time Jesus cried out just before He died, and gave the verses up to His death

children-batch4:assu:1817.question: When the soldiers saw that Jesus had already died, what did one soldier do?
children-batch4:assu:1817.answer: Pierced His side with a spear
wrong: Took Him down from the cross
children-batch4:assu:1817.why: Named the soldiers and Jesus; told gently

children-batch4:assu:1818.question: What flowed out of Jesus' side when the soldier pierced it?
children-batch4:assu:1818.why: Made it stand on its own; used BSB wording

children-batch4:assu:1819.question: Who asked Pilate to let him take away the body of Jesus?

children-batch4:assu:182.question: How many sons did Jacob have?

children-batch4:assu:1820.question: What was Joseph of Arimathea, in secret?
children-batch4:assu:1820.why: Named Joseph so the question stands on its own

children-batch4:assu:1821.question: Why did Joseph of Arimathea follow Jesus in secret?
children-batch4:assu:1821.answer: He was afraid of the Jews
wrong: He was too busy at work
Jesus told him to do that

children-batch4:assu:1822.question: What did Pilate do when Joseph of Arimathea asked for the body of Jesus?
children-batch4:assu:1822.why: Changed the yes-or-no question to one with four choices; named the people

children-batch4:assu:1823.question: Where did Joseph lay the body of Jesus?
wrong: In a boat by the sea

children-batch4:assu:1824.question: What was Joseph's new tomb cut into?

children-batch4:assu:1825.question: How did Joseph of Arimathea close the entrance of Jesus' tomb?
children-batch4:assu:1825.answer: He rolled a big stone across it
wrong: He locked a heavy wooden door
He hung a long cloth over it
He filled it up with sand
children-batch4:assu:1825.why: Named Joseph and the tomb; used BSB wording
children-batch4:assu:1825.fixed: 'Joseph' alone could mean Mary's husband Joseph. The question should name Joseph of Arimathea, as Matthew 27:57 does.

children-batch4:assu:1826.question: How did the chief priests and Pharisees make Jesus' tomb secure?
children-batch4:assu:1826.answer: Sealed the stone and posted a guard
wrong: Built a tall wall all around it
Locked it shut with a key
Covered it up with tree branches
children-batch4:assu:1826.why: Added the chief priests (named in v.62); BSB wording 'posting the guard'

children-batch4:assu:1827.question: Who went to Jesus' tomb early on the first day of the week, while it was still dark?

children-batch4:assu:1828.question: At what time did Mary Magdalene, Mary the mother of James, and Salome go to Jesus' tomb on the first day of the week?
wrong: At noon, in the hot sun
children-batch4:assu:1828.why: Made it stand on its own and followed Mark's wording, which speaks of the women
children-batch4:assu:1828.fixed: The question only said 'the women'. Mark 16:1 names them, so the question should say who they were.

children-batch4:assu:1829.question: When Mary Magdalene saw the stone moved away from Jesus' tomb, whom did she run to tell?
children-batch4:assu:1829.answer: Peter and the disciple Jesus loved
wrong: The Roman guards at the gate
children-batch4:assu:1829.why: Named Mary; 'stone removed' instead of 'empty'; BSB says 'the disciple Jesus loved', not John

children-batch4:assu:183.question: In the Bible, what are Jacob's twelve sons called?

children-batch4:assu:1830.question: When the disciple Jesus loved looked into the tomb, what did he see?

children-batch4:assu:1831.question: Who stood outside Jesus' tomb crying?
children-batch4:assu:1831.why: Named the tomb, used BSB wording ('stood outside... weeping'), removed 'tarried' and 'sepulchre'
children-batch4:assu:1831.fixed: Just 'Mary' does not say which Mary. The verses around (John 20:1) show it was Mary Magdalene, so the answer should use her full name.

children-batch4:assu:1832.question: When Mary Magdalene bent down to look into Jesus' tomb, whom did she see?
children-batch4:assu:1832.fixed: 'Mary' alone is unclear because the Bible has many Marys. The story shows this is Mary Magdalene, so the question should say so.

children-batch4:assu:1833.question: Where were the two angels sitting in Jesus' tomb?
children-batch4:assu:1833.answer: One at the head, one at the feet
wrong: Both sitting up on the big stone
Both sitting just outside the door
Both sitting high up on the roof
children-batch4:assu:1833.why: Named the angels, shortened the answer

children-batch4:assu:1834.question: What did the angels in the tomb ask Mary?
children-batch4:assu:1834.why: Named the angels and Mary, used BSB words

children-batch4:assu:1835.question: When the angels asked Mary Magdalene why she was crying, what did she answer?
wrong: "I came to roll the stone away."
"I am looking for Peter and John."
"I came to pray here by myself."
children-batch4:assu:1835.why: Named Mary and the angels, used BSB words
children-batch4:assu:1835.fixed: The question should name Mary Magdalene, not just 'Mary', and should say what the angels asked her.

children-batch4:assu:1836.question: When Mary turned around, whom did she see standing there?

children-batch4:assu:1837.question: When Mary Magdalene first saw Jesus standing near the tomb, what was true?
children-batch4:assu:1837.answer: She did not know it was Jesus
wrong: She saw no one there at all
children-batch4:assu:1837.why: Changed yes-or-no question to four choices, named Mary
children-batch4:assu:1837.fixed: The question should name Mary Magdalene, not just 'Mary'. The answer itself matches John 20:14.

children-batch4:assu:1838.question: At the tomb, who did Mary Magdalene think Jesus was?
children-batch4:assu:1838.why: Named Mary and Jesus, simpler words
children-batch4:assu:1838.fixed: The question should name Mary Magdalene (John 20:18) and say this happened at the tomb.

children-batch4:assu:1839.question: What one word did Jesus say to Mary next?

children-batch4:assu:184.question: Which of his sons did Jacob love most?

children-batch4:assu:1840.question: When Jesus said her name, what did Mary say to Him?

children-batch4:assu:1842.question: Which two women went to see Jesus' tomb and then met Jesus?
children-batch4:assu:1842.answer: Mary Magdalene and the other Mary
children-batch4:assu:1842.why: Made it stand alone from Matthew's account; verse 9 added to reference

children-batch4:assu:1843.question: What did Jesus say when He met Mary Magdalene and the other Mary?
children-batch4:assu:1843.why: Named Jesus and the women, BSB 'Greetings!' for 'All hail'

children-batch4:assu:1844.question: What did Mary Magdalene and the other Mary do when Jesus met them?
children-batch4:assu:1844.answer: Grasped His feet and worshiped Him
wrong: Ran away and hid in fear
Sat down on the ground and cried
children-batch4:assu:1844.why: Named the women, used BSB wording

children-batch4:assu:1845.question: The disciples said, "The Lord has indeed risen and has appeared to ___!" Whom did He appear to?
children-batch4:assu:1845.why: Made it stand alone with BSB words; reference corrected to Luke 24:34

children-batch4:assu:1846.question: On the day Jesus rose, who walked with Him on the road to Emmaus?
children-batch4:assu:1846.why: Named Jesus and Emmaus; plain words

children-batch4:assu:1847.question: How far was the village of Emmaus from Jerusalem?
children-batch4:assu:1847.why: Distance changed to match the BSB (about seven miles)

children-batch4:assu:1848.question: What were the two disciples talking about on the road to Emmaus?

children-batch4:assu:1849.question: As the two disciples talked on the road, who came up and walked along with them?

children-batch4:assu:185.question: Why did Jacob love Joseph more than his other sons?
children-batch4:assu:185.answer: He was born when Jacob was old
wrong: He was the strongest of all
He was Jacob's very first son
He was the best shepherd there
children-batch4:assu:185.why: Made it stand alone; simpler words

children-batch4:assu:1850.question: Why did the two disciples not know it was Jesus walking with them?
children-batch4:assu:1850.answer: Their eyes were kept from knowing Him
wrong: It was too dark to see Him
They were too sleepy to look
Jesus walked too far away from them
children-batch4:assu:1850.why: Named who; BSB wording for the answer

children-batch4:assu:1851.question: What did Jesus explain to the two disciples on the road?
children-batch4:assu:1851.answer: What the Scriptures said about Him
wrong: How to catch more fish in nets
How to build a strong house
The best road to go to Egypt

children-batch4:assu:1852.question: As they came near the village of Emmaus, what did Jesus seem to do?
children-batch4:assu:1852.answer: He seemed to be going farther
wrong: He sat down by the road

children-batch4:assu:1853.question: What did the two disciples beg Jesus to do when it was nearly evening?

children-batch4:assu:1854.question: How did the two disciples come to know it was Jesus?
wrong: When He told them His name
When He showed them a map

children-batch4:assu:1855.question: What did Jesus do right after the two disciples knew Him?
wrong: He fell asleep at the table
He went out to the market
He ate up all the bread

children-batch4:assu:1856.question: What did the two disciples ask each other after Jesus disappeared?
children-batch4:assu:1856.answer: "Were not our hearts burning within us?"
children-batch4:assu:1856.why: Quote changed to BSB; named who

children-batch4:assu:1857.question: To what city did the two disciples go back that very hour?

children-batch4:assu:1858.question: Who did the two disciples find gathered together in Jerusalem?

children-batch4:assu:1859.question: What did the two disciples tell the Eleven in Jerusalem?
children-batch4:assu:1859.answer: How they knew Jesus when He broke bread
wrong: That they got lost on the road home
That they found a box of gold
That they had to sell their donkey

children-batch4:assu:186.question: What did Jacob make for Joseph to show his love?
children-batch4:assu:186.why: Simpler words; BSB 'robe of many colors'

children-batch4:assu:1860.question: While the two disciples were telling their story, who stood among them and said, "Peace be with you"?

children-batch4:assu:1861.question: What did Jesus say when He stood among His disciples?
children-batch4:assu:1861.why: Named Jesus and the disciples; BSB wording

children-batch4:assu:1862.question: Why were the disciples afraid when Jesus stood among them?
children-batch4:assu:1862.answer: They thought they saw a spirit.
wrong: They thought He was a soldier.
They thought the house was on fire.

children-batch4:assu:1863.question: What did Jesus do to show His disciples He was not a spirit?
children-batch4:assu:1863.answer: He ate a piece of fish.
wrong: He sang them a happy song.
He rode in on a donkey.
He climbed up a tall tree.

children-batch4:assu:1864.question: After Jesus rose from the dead, which of the twelve disciples was not with the others when Jesus came to them?
children-batch4:assu:1864.why: Made it stand alone; simpler words
children-batch4:assu:1864.fixed: The question said only 'when Jesus came', so a child could not tell when that was. It now says this was when Jesus came to the disciples after He rose from the dead.

children-batch4:assu:1865.question: What did Thomas do when the other disciples told him, "We have seen the Lord!"?
wrong: He ran to tell his mother.
children-batch4:assu:1865.why: Yes/no made into four choices; named Thomas

children-batch4:assu:1866.question: What did Thomas say he must do before he would believe Jesus was alive?
children-batch4:assu:1866.answer: Touch the nail marks in His hands
wrong: Hear Jesus sing a song to him
See Jesus walk on the water
Eat a big meal with Jesus
children-batch4:assu:1866.why: Named Thomas; BSB facts in child words

children-batch4:assu:1867.question: After Jesus first came to His disciples, how many days later were they together again, with Thomas there too?
children-batch4:assu:1867.why: Named the disciples and Thomas; simpler words
children-batch4:assu:1867.fixed: The question asked 'how many days later' without saying later than what. It now says this was after Jesus first came to the disciples.

children-batch4:assu:1868.question: Who came and stood among the disciples when the doors were locked?
children-batch4:assu:1868.why: Made it stand alone; 'in the midst' simplified

children-batch4:assu:1869.question: What did Jesus tell Thomas to do?
children-batch4:assu:1869.answer: Touch His hands and side, and believe
wrong: Go away and wait outside the door
Bring Him some bread and fish
Go fishing out on the sea
children-batch4:assu:1869.why: Named Jesus; BSB wording in child words

children-batch4:assu:187.question: How did Joseph's brothers feel when they saw their father loved Joseph more?

children-batch4:assu:1870.question: What did Thomas say when Jesus showed him His hands and side?

children-batch4:assu:1871.question: After Jesus rose from the dead, how many of His followers did He appear to all at one time?
children-batch4:assu:1871.why: Named Jesus; BSB 'more than five hundred'
children-batch4:assu:1871.fixed: Here 'brothers' means fellow believers, but a child might think it means Jesus' own brothers. The question now says 'followers'.

children-batch4:assu:1872.question: After Jesus rose from the dead, over how many days did He appear to His followers?
children-batch4:assu:1872.why: Matched BSB: appeared over forty days; simpler words

children-batch4:assu:1873.question: In what city did Jesus tell His disciples to wait for the Holy Spirit, the gift the Father promised?

children-batch4:assu:1874.question: What job did Jesus give His disciples?
children-batch4:assu:1874.answer: Preach the gospel in all the world
wrong: Stay at home and keep very quiet
Build a big new temple for God
Go back to fishing on the sea

children-batch4:assu:1875.question: When Jesus sent His disciples to make disciples of all nations, what did He promise them?
children-batch4:assu:1875.fixed: The words 'to cheer them' are not in the verses. The question now ties the promise to the time Jesus sent His disciples out to make disciples.

children-batch4:assu:1876.question: To what town did Jesus lead His disciples before He went up into heaven?
children-batch4:assu:1876.why: Named Jesus and the disciples; plain words

children-batch4:assu:1877.question: What did Jesus do with His hands when He led the disciples out to Bethany?
children-batch4:assu:1877.answer: He lifted them and blessed them
wrong: He broke bread for them all
He wrote words in the sand
children-batch4:assu:1877.why: Named Jesus and the place; BSB wording

children-batch4:assu:1878.question: What happened to Jesus while He was blessing His disciples?
children-batch4:assu:1878.answer: He was carried up into heaven
wrong: He fell asleep in a boat
He walked back home to Galilee
He went inside the big temple
children-batch4:assu:1878.why: Made it stand alone; BSB wording

children-batch4:assu:1879.question: Who suddenly stood beside the disciples as they watched Jesus go up into the sky?
children-batch4:assu:1879.why: Made it stand alone; BSB wording

children-batch4:assu:188.question: What did Joseph tell his father about his brothers?
wrong: That the sheep were all lost
children-batch4:assu:188.why: Reworded to what the verse says; dropped 'probably'

children-batch4:assu:1880.question: How did the two men dressed in white say Jesus would come back?
children-batch4:assu:1880.answer: The same way He went up
children-batch4:assu:1880.why: Named the two men; BSB wording

children-batch4:assu:1881.question: To what city did the disciples go back after Jesus went up into heaven?
children-batch4:assu:1881.why: Named the disciples and the event

children-batch4:assu:1882.question: From what mountain did the disciples walk back to Jerusalem after Jesus went up into heaven?

children-batch4:assu:1883.question: How far was the Mount of Olives from Jerusalem?

children-batch4:assu:1884.dropped: The Bible never gives the length of a Sabbath day's journey

children-batch4:assu:1885.question: What did the disciples keep doing in the temple after Jesus went up into heaven?
children-batch4:assu:1885.why: Matched the answer to BSB; fixed the reference

children-batch4:assu:1886.dropped: No Bible verse names Luke as the writer of Acts; this comes from tradition

children-batch4:assu:1887.question: To whom was the book of Acts written?

children-batch4:assu:1888.question: What other book of the Bible was written for Theophilus?

children-batch4:assu:1889.question: Where did the disciples stay in Jerusalem after Jesus went up into heaven?

children-batch4:assu:189.question: What did Joseph ask his brothers to listen to?

children-batch4:assu:1890.question: About how many believers were gathered together when Peter stood up to speak?
children-batch4:assu:1890.why: Made it stand alone; 'about' as in BSB

children-batch4:assu:1891.question: After Jesus went up to heaven, who stood up and spoke to the group of about 120 believers?
children-batch4:assu:1891.why: Named the group and the time; plain wording

children-batch4:assu:1892.question: Peter wanted the believers to choose a new apostle. Whose place would the new apostle take?
children-batch4:assu:1892.why: Named Peter; plain wording instead of 'in whose stead'

children-batch4:assu:1893.question: What did Judas do with the silver he was paid for handing Jesus over?
children-batch4:assu:1893.answer: He threw it into the temple
wrong: He gave it to the poor
He buried it in a field
He gave it to Jesus' mother
children-batch4:assu:1893.why: Asked gently about what Judas did with the silver instead of making his death the point

children-batch4:assu:1894.question: Which two men did the believers put forward to take Judas's place?
children-batch4:assu:1894.why: Named the event; BSB spelling Barsabbas

children-batch4:assu:1895.question: How did the disciples choose between Barsabbas and Matthias?

children-batch4:assu:1896.question: When the disciples cast lots, who was chosen to be the new apostle?

children-batch4:assu:1897.question: After the lot fell to Matthias, who was he added to?

children-batch4:assu:1898.question: Where were the disciples when the day of Pentecost came?

children-batch4:assu:1899.question: In the Old Testament, how many days were God's people to count before the feast we call Pentecost?
children-batch4:assu:1899.why: Asked what the given verses say: count fifty days

children-batch4:assu:19.question: What did God tell the earth to grow on the third day?
children-batch4:assu:19.why: made it stand alone; 'vegetables' changed to BSB plants and fruit trees

children-batch4:assu:190.question: In Joseph's first dream, what were he and his brothers doing in the field?

children-batch4:assu:1900.question: What other names does the Old Testament give the feast of Pentecost?
children-batch4:assu:1900.answer: The Feast of Harvest and the Feast of Weeks

The Feast of Bread and the Feast of Lambs

children-batch4:assu:1901.question: On the day of Pentecost, what sound suddenly came from heaven?

children-batch4:assu:1902.answer: The whole house they were in

children-batch4:assu:1903.question: What did the disciples see on the day of Pentecost?

children-batch4:assu:1906.question: When the disciples were filled with the Holy Spirit, how did they begin to speak?
children-batch4:assu:1906.why: Named the disciples; BSB wording; simpler words

children-batch4:assu:1907.why: Named the disciples; 'gave utterance' made plain

children-batch4:assu:1909.question: How did each person in the crowd hear the disciples speaking?

children-batch4:assu:191.question: In Joseph's first dream, what did his brothers' bundles of grain do?
wrong: Blew far away in the wind

children-batch4:assu:1910.question: How did the crowd feel when they heard the disciples speaking their own languages?
children-batch4:assu:1910.why: Named the crowd; BSB 'astounded and amazed'

children-batch4:assu:1955.why: Named Stephen; BSB wording 'grace and power'.

children-batch4:assu:233.why: Added who and when; kept to what verse 14 says

Go and ask your magicians, not me

children-batch4:assu:247.fixed: The old question said the brothers had to bring back their youngest brother "before the rest could go home." But Joseph let them go home with grain first and told them to bring the youngest brother back later. Verse 19 says this was to show they were honest.

children-batch4:assu:248.question: Which of his brothers did Joseph keep in Egypt when he sent the rest home with grain?

wrong: Kept it safe in his own house

Threw it into the Nile River

children-batch4:assu:252.why: King James answer changed to BSB words

"Bring me gifts of gold and silver!"

Send me more silver and gold

children-batch4:assu:266.answer: Because he did not believe them
