children-batch4:assu:328.question: When Moses went over to look, who called to him from inside the burning bush?

children-batch4:assu:329.question: When God said, "I am the God of Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob," what did Moses do?

children-batch4:assu:33.question: God told the serpent that someone would crush its head. Who would do it?

children-batch4:assu:330.question: Why did Moses hide his face at the burning bush?
children-batch4:assu:330.answer: He was afraid to look at God
wrong: The fire was far too hot for him
He was very tired and sleepy
He wanted to play a game

children-batch4:assu:331.question: Why did the LORD say He had come down when He spoke to Moses from the burning bush?
children-batch4:assu:331.answer: To rescue His people from Egypt
wrong: To build a city in the desert
To send rain on the land
children-batch4:assu:331.why: Named the Lord and the burning bush; simpler words

children-batch4:assu:332.question: To whom did God send Moses?
children-batch4:assu:332.why: Named God and Moses; simpler words

children-batch4:assu:333.question: Why did God send Moses to Pharaoh?
children-batch4:assu:333.answer: To bring the Israelites out of Egypt
wrong: To ask Pharaoh for lots of gold
To become Pharaoh's helper in the palace
To build Pharaoh a brand new palace
children-batch4:assu:333.why: Made it stand alone; BSB wording

children-batch4:assu:334.question: What did Moses ask God when God told him to go to Pharaoh?
children-batch4:assu:334.answer: "Who am I, that I should go to Pharaoh?"
wrong: "When can I leave to go to Egypt?"
"Will Pharaoh give me gold and fine clothes?"
"Can I take all my sheep with me?"

children-batch4:assu:335.question: What did God promise Moses when Moses asked, "Who am I?"
children-batch4:assu:335.why: Made it stand alone; BSB wording

children-batch4:assu:336.question: What name of God did God tell Moses to say to the Israelites had sent him?

children-batch4:assu:337.question: What was Moses worried the Israelites would do?
children-batch4:assu:337.answer: Not believe or listen to him
wrong: Run far away from him in fear
Make him their king right away
Laugh at his old wooden staff

children-batch4:assu:338.question: What did God make Moses' staff turn into, so the people would believe Moses?
children-batch4:assu:338.why: Made answer concrete from the verses

children-batch4:assu:339.question: What did Moses say about his speaking, so he would not have to go?

children-batch4:assu:34.question: God promised that the woman's seed would crush the serpent's head. Who is that seed?
children-batch4:assu:34.why: Added a reference naming Christ as born of a woman

children-batch4:assu:340.question: Who did God say would speak to the people for Moses?

children-batch4:assu:341.question: How was Aaron related to Moses?

children-batch4:assu:342.question: Where did Moses and Aaron meet each other?

children-batch4:assu:343.question: What was the name of the mountain of God where Moses met Aaron?

children-batch4:assu:344.question: After Moses told Aaron all that the LORD said, who did Moses and Aaron gather together?

children-batch4:assu:345.question: What did Aaron tell the elders of the Israelites?

children-batch4:assu:346.question: When the Israelites heard that the LORD had seen their trouble, what did they do?
wrong: They laughed at Moses and Aaron
children-batch4:assu:346.why: Named the Israelites; BSB wording; simpler words

children-batch4:assu:347.question: What message from the LORD did Moses and Aaron first give to Pharaoh?
children-batch4:assu:347.answer: Let My people go to feast in the wilderness
wrong: Build Me a great temple in the land of Egypt
Make Moses a king over all of Egypt
Give My people gold and silver to keep
children-batch4:assu:347.why: BSB wording of the message; simpler words

children-batch4:assu:348.question: What did Pharaoh answer when Moses and Aaron asked him to let Israel go?
children-batch4:assu:348.answer: Who is the LORD that I should obey Him?
wrong: I will gladly let all your people go
Let me ask my wise men about it first
Your God is very welcome here in Egypt
children-batch4:assu:348.why: Named Pharaoh and what he was answering; BSB wording

children-batch4:assu:349.question: When Moses and Aaron asked Pharaoh to let Israel go, what did Pharaoh say about knowing the LORD?
children-batch4:assu:349.answer: I do not know the LORD
wrong: I know the LORD very well
I have met the LORD before
I want to know the LORD
children-batch4:assu:349.why: Named Pharaoh so it stands alone; BSB wording
children-batch4:assu:349.fixed: The question says 'What else', so it only makes sense right after the question before it. It doesn't say when Pharaoh said this.

children-batch4:assu:35.question: Because of whom did God curse the ground so it would grow thorns and thistles?

children-batch4:assu:350.question: What did Pharaoh say the Israelites were?

children-batch4:assu:351.question: What did Pharaoh order to be done to the Israelites' work?
children-batch4:assu:351.why: Simpler words; matched BSB 'make the work harder'

children-batch4:assu:352.question: In Exodus 6, what did the LORD promise again to do for the Israelites?
children-batch4:assu:352.answer: Bring them out from under the Egyptians
wrong: Make them rulers over all of Egypt
Give them new houses in Egypt
Make Pharaoh their good, kind friend
children-batch4:assu:352.fixed: The verse says 'yoke', not 'heavy yoke', so 'heavy' was added. 'Yoke' is also a hard word for a child.

children-batch4:assu:353.question: What did the LORD promise to set the Israelites free from?

children-batch4:assu:354.question: Why did the Israelites not listen to Moses when he told them the LORD's promise?
children-batch4:assu:354.answer: Their spirits were broken and their slavery was cruel
wrong: They were busy having a feast
They could not hear his voice
children-batch4:assu:354.why: Removed 'hearken'; BSB wording in simple words

children-batch4:assu:355.question: How did the LORD say He would rescue the Israelites from Egypt?
children-batch4:assu:355.answer: With an outstretched arm and mighty acts of judgment
wrong: With a big army of soldiers
With gifts of gold for Pharaoh
With a long trip on a boat

children-batch4:assu:356.question: What did the LORD say the Egyptians would know when He brought Israel out?
wrong: That Egypt was the strongest land
children-batch4:assu:356.why: Added who is speaking and when, so it stands alone

children-batch4:assu:357.question: What happened to Aaron's staff when he threw it down before Pharaoh?
children-batch4:assu:357.why: Asked about the staff simply; BSB 'staff'; added the verse where it happens

children-batch4:assu:358.question: How many plagues did God send on Egypt before Pharaoh let Israel go?
children-batch4:assu:358.why: Simpler words; the verse given does not count the plagues, so pointed to the whole account

children-batch4:assu:359.question: What was the first plague God sent on Egypt?
children-batch4:assu:359.answer: The water of the Nile turned to blood
wrong: The water of the Nile dried up
The water of the Nile turned to gold
children-batch4:assu:359.why: Named the plagues so it stands alone; BSB 'Nile'

children-batch4:assu:360.question: How many days passed after the LORD struck the Nile River and turned it to blood?
children-batch4:assu:360.why: Named the plague so it stands alone
children-batch4:assu:360.fixed: 'Stay that way' is unclear. The verse also doesn't say the river stayed blood for exactly that long. It only says seven full days passed after the LORD struck the Nile.

children-batch4:assu:361.question: What was the second plague God sent on Egypt?
children-batch4:assu:361.why: Named Egypt so it stands alone; added wrong choices

children-batch4:assu:362.question: What did Pharaoh promise if the frogs were taken away?

children-batch4:assu:363.question: What did Pharaoh do when he saw the frogs were gone?
children-batch4:assu:363.why: Named Pharaoh and the frogs so it stands alone

children-batch4:assu:364.question: What was the third plague God sent on Egypt?
children-batch4:assu:364.why: Changed lice to gnats as in the BSB

children-batch4:assu:365.question: What did Pharaoh's magicians say about the plague of gnats?

children-batch4:assu:366.question: What was the fourth plague God sent on Egypt?
children-batch4:assu:366.why: Made it stand alone; answer worded as in the BSB

children-batch4:assu:367.question: In what part of Egypt were there no flies, because God's people lived there?
children-batch4:assu:367.why: Said which plague it was so it stands alone

children-batch4:assu:368.question: When Moses prayed for Pharaoh, what did the LORD do with the flies?
children-batch4:assu:368.why: Simpler words; answer follows the BSB

children-batch4:assu:369.question: In the fifth plague, what died in Egypt?
wrong: All the fish in the river
All the birds in the sky
children-batch4:assu:369.why: Said gently; answer follows the BSB (the Egyptians' livestock, not Israel's)

children-batch4:assu:37.question: What did Cain bring as an offering to the LORD?

children-batch4:assu:370.question: What came on the people and animals of Egypt in the sixth plague?
children-batch4:assu:370.why: Changed 'boils and blains' to the BSB's boils, in plain words

children-batch4:assu:371.question: After the plague of hail and thunder, what did Pharaoh say to Moses and Aaron?

children-batch4:assu:372.question: When the hail and thunder stopped, what did Pharaoh do?
children-batch4:assu:372.answer: He sinned and hardened his heart
wrong: He let God's people go at once
He gave Moses a big reward
He asked to worship the LORD
children-batch4:assu:372.why: Named the plague; fixed the reference (it was printed as Ex. xi)

children-batch4:assu:373.question: What was the eighth plague God sent on Egypt?
children-batch4:assu:373.why: Made it stand alone; answer follows the BSB

children-batch4:assu:374.question: What was the ninth plague God sent on Egypt?
wrong: A flood over all the land
children-batch4:assu:374.why: Made it stand alone; answer follows the BSB

children-batch4:assu:375.question: How long did the darkness cover the land of Egypt?
children-batch4:assu:375.why: Named the darkness so it stands alone

children-batch4:assu:376.question: During the three days of darkness in Egypt, what did the Israelites have in their homes?
children-batch4:assu:376.why: Named the darkness plague and the Israelites; made it a choice question

children-batch4:assu:377.question: What was the last and worst plague on Egypt?
children-batch4:assu:377.why: Simpler words, told gently; 'firstborn' as the BSB has it

children-batch4:assu:378.question: What special service did God give Israel to remember how He passed over their homes in Egypt?
children-batch4:assu:378.why: Simpler words; named the plague and God passing over the homes

children-batch4:assu:379.question: What animal did each Israelite family choose for the Passover?
children-batch4:assu:379.why: Named the Passover; no goat among the wrong choices, since Exodus 12:5 allows one

children-batch4:assu:38.question: What did Abel bring as an offering to the LORD?
children-batch4:assu:38.answer: The best of the firstborn of his flock
wrong: Bread and a jar of water

children-batch4:assu:380.question: How were the Israelites to eat the Passover meal?
children-batch4:assu:380.answer: Quickly, dressed and ready to travel
wrong: A little each day for many days
children-batch4:assu:380.why: Named the meal; answer follows the BSB (in haste, dressed for travel)
children-batch4:assu:380.fixed: The wrong choice 'Over many days, at a feast' could look partly right, because Exodus 12:14 calls the day a feast to the LORD. I changed it to something the verses clearly rule out: Exodus 12:10 says nothing may be left until morning.

children-batch4:assu:381.question: How did the Israelites leave Egypt?
children-batch4:assu:381.answer: They were driven out in a hurry
wrong: They waited many weeks to go
children-batch4:assu:381.why: 'Thrust out' changed to the BSB's 'driven out'

children-batch4:assu:382.question: How many years had the Israelites lived in Egypt when they left?
children-batch4:assu:382.why: Took out the Abraham claim, which the verse does not make; asked how long Israel lived in Egypt, as the BSB says

children-batch4:assu:383.dropped: No Bible passage gives 215 years; the figure is a commentator's working-out

children-batch4:assu:384.question: About how many men on foot left Egypt, besides the women and children?
children-batch4:assu:384.why: 'Two millions' is a guess; asked for the 600,000 men the verse gives

children-batch4:assu:385.question: When the Israelites left Egypt, which road was shorter, even though God did not lead them that way?
wrong: The road through the Red Sea
The road back to Pharaoh's palace
children-batch4:assu:385.fixed: The question did not say who was traveling or why the road matters. I added that it was the shorter road out of Egypt that God did not lead Israel along.

children-batch4:assu:386.question: After Pharaoh let the Israelites go, which way did God lead them?
children-batch4:assu:386.answer: Through the desert to the Red Sea
wrong: On the short road through Philistine land
Back toward Pharaoh's palace in Egypt
Down the river Nile in boats
children-batch4:assu:386.fixed: The question did not say when this happened. I added that it was after the Israelites left Egypt, as Exodus 13:17-18 shows.

children-batch4:assu:387.question: Why did God not lead the Israelites the shorter way?
children-batch4:assu:387.answer: If they faced war, they might go back to Egypt
wrong: Moses did not know the way
children-batch4:assu:387.why: Made it stand on its own; 'repent' changed to 'change their minds'

children-batch4:assu:388.question: What did Moses take with him when he left Egypt?
children-batch4:assu:388.why: Kept; wrong choices leave out gold and silver, which Israel did take

children-batch4:assu:389.question: Why did Moses carry Joseph's bones out of Egypt?
children-batch4:assu:389.answer: Joseph had made the Israelites promise to take them
wrong: Pharaoh told him to take them
Aaron wanted to bury them in Egypt
children-batch4:assu:389.why: Made it stand on its own; simpler words
children-batch4:assu:389.fixed: Genesis 50:25 does not say that Moses carried the bones. Exodus 13:19 says it, and it also gives the reason, so it is the better reference. The answer's 'them' did not say who promised. 'Pharaoh told him to' and 'An Egyptian king asked him to' mean the same thing, so one was swapped.

children-batch4:assu:39.question: Whose offering did the LORD look on with favor, Cain's or Abel's?
children-batch4:assu:39.why: Made it stand alone; BSB 'looked with favor'

children-batch4:assu:390.question: How did the LORD lead the Israelites by day?
children-batch4:assu:390.why: Kept; 'the LORD' as in the BSB

children-batch4:assu:391.question: How did the LORD lead the Israelites by night?
children-batch4:assu:391.why: Made it stand alone; wrong choices added

children-batch4:assu:392.question: When Pharaoh heard that the Israelites had left Egypt, what did he do?
wrong: He let them go in peace

children-batch4:assu:393.question: How did the Israelites feel when they saw the Egyptians coming after them?
children-batch4:assu:393.why: Simpler words; answer follows the BSB 'terrified'

children-batch4:assu:394.question: Who did the Israelites cry out to when they saw the Egyptians coming?
children-batch4:assu:394.why: Made it stand alone; removed King James wording

children-batch4:assu:395.question: What came between the camps of Egypt and Israel all night?
children-batch4:assu:395.why: Follows BSB wording about the camps

children-batch4:assu:396.question: What did the pillar of cloud do to the camps of Egypt and Israel all night long?
children-batch4:assu:396.why: The BSB does not say the cloud was dark to the Egyptians, so the question now asks what the verse does say

children-batch4:assu:397.question: What did the pillar of cloud do to the dark night by the sea?
children-batch4:assu:397.why: Made it stand alone; follows BSB 'lit up the night'

children-batch4:assu:398.question: What did God tell Moses to stretch out over the sea?
children-batch4:assu:398.why: Simpler words; reference set to God's command

children-batch4:assu:399.question: What did the Israelites walk on as they went through the sea?

children-batch4:assu:4.question: How can we know the Bible comes from God?
children-batch4:assu:4.answer: It tells things only God could know
wrong: It is a very long book
children-batch4:assu:4.why: Simpler words; added a passage that holds the answer

children-batch4:assu:40.question: Why was Abel's offering better than Cain's?
wrong: Adam told him what to bring

children-batch4:assu:400.question: What did the Egyptians do when the Israelites went through the sea?

children-batch4:assu:401.question: What happened to Pharaoh's army in the sea?
wrong: They crossed to the other side
children-batch4:assu:401.why: Told gently, using the verse's words

children-batch4:assu:402.question: How did Moses and the Israelites praise God after crossing the sea?
children-batch4:assu:402.answer: They sang a song to the LORD
wrong: They built a tall stone tower
They had a big feast together
They all went back to Egypt

children-batch4:assu:403.question: After leaving the Red Sea, for how many days did the Israelites walk in the desert without water?

children-batch4:assu:404.question: After three days without water, what place did the Israelites come to?

children-batch4:assu:405.question: Why could the Israelites not drink the water at Marah?

children-batch4:assu:406.question: How did the bitter water at Marah become sweet?
children-batch4:assu:406.answer: Moses threw in a log God showed him
wrong: Moses hit the water with his staff
The people poured lots of honey into it
Aaron stirred it with his own hand
children-batch4:assu:406.why: Named the place; BSB 'log' instead of 'tree'; simpler words

children-batch4:assu:407.question: After Marah, what place did the Israelites come to next?
children-batch4:assu:407.why: Named the Israelites and Marah so it stands alone

children-batch4:assu:408.question: What did the Israelites find at Elim?
children-batch4:assu:408.answer: Twelve springs of water and seventy palm trees
wrong: Seven wells and ten fig trees
A big river and a city
A tall mountain and a cave

children-batch4:assu:409.question: What desert did the Israelites come to after they left Elim?

children-batch4:assu:41.question: What does the Bible say faith is?
children-batch4:assu:41.answer: Being sure of what we hope for and cannot see
wrong: Being sure only of what we can see and touch
Doing as many good things as we possibly can
Just making a guess about what God is like

children-batch4:assu:410.question: What did the Israelites do in the Desert of Sin?
children-batch4:assu:410.answer: They grumbled against Moses and Aaron
wrong: They sang songs of thanks to God
They all went back to Egypt

children-batch4:assu:411.question: When the Israelites grumbled, why did they say Moses and Aaron had brought them into the desert?
children-batch4:assu:411.why: Named who; told gently in plain words

children-batch4:assu:412.question: What birds did God send to the Israelites' camp for meat?

children-batch4:assu:413.question: What did Moses tell the Israelites the strange flakes on the ground were?
children-batch4:assu:413.why: Reworded to what the verse says Moses told them

children-batch4:assu:414.question: What did the Israelites call the bread God gave them in the desert?

children-batch4:assu:415.question: What did the manna look like and taste like?
children-batch4:assu:415.answer: White like coriander seed, tasting like honey wafers
wrong: Brown like dirt, tasting like salt

children-batch4:assu:416.question: Where did the Israelites find the manna?
children-batch4:assu:416.answer: On the ground, in thin flakes
wrong: Hanging high on the palm trees

children-batch4:assu:417.question: How often did the Israelites gather manna?
children-batch4:assu:417.answer: Every morning for six days, not on the Sabbath
wrong: Only once a week, on the Sabbath
children-batch4:assu:417.why: Named who and what; answer follows both verses

children-batch4:assu:418.question: How did the Israelites have manna to eat on the Sabbath?
children-batch4:assu:418.answer: They gathered twice as much the day before
wrong: They gathered it on the Sabbath morning
They ate only quail on that day
They had nothing to eat that day

children-batch4:assu:419.question: Why did God tell Moses to keep some manna?
children-batch4:assu:419.answer: So children later on could see it
wrong: So it could be sold in Egypt
So it could feed the animals
So it could be planted as seed
children-batch4:assu:419.why: Simpler words; added the reason the verse gives

children-batch4:assu:42.question: What does the Bible say about pleasing God without faith?
wrong: It is easy if you are good
Anyone can if they try hard

children-batch4:assu:420.question: How long did the Israelites eat manna?

children-batch4:assu:421.question: What did the Israelites not have at Rephidim?

children-batch4:assu:422.question: Who did the thirsty Israelites grumble against at Rephidim?

children-batch4:assu:423.question: How did God tell Moses to get water for the people?
children-batch4:assu:423.answer: Strike the rock with his staff
wrong: Dig a deep well in the sand
Go back to the Nile River
Wait for the rain to fall
children-batch4:assu:423.why: Simpler words; 'smite' changed to 'strike', as in the BSB

children-batch4:assu:424.question: Who came and attacked the Israelites at Rephidim?

children-batch4:assu:425.question: Who did Moses send to lead Israel's men in the fight against the Amalekites?
children-batch4:assu:425.why: Now names the battle, so it makes sense alone

children-batch4:assu:426.question: Who won the battle between Israel and the Amalekites?

children-batch4:assu:427.question: Who came to visit Moses in the desert?
children-batch4:assu:427.answer: Jethro, with Moses' wife and sons
children-batch4:assu:427.why: Follows the verse: they came to the mountain of God, and only 'sons' is said

children-batch4:assu:428.question: What did Moses tell his father-in-law Jethro?
children-batch4:assu:428.answer: All that the LORD had done for Israel
wrong: How to build a big city
That he wanted to go back to Egypt
children-batch4:assu:428.why: Named Jethro as Moses' father-in-law; added wrong choices

children-batch4:assu:429.question: Why was Jethro glad?
children-batch4:assu:429.answer: Because the LORD had done good for Israel
wrong: Because Moses gave him a bag of gold
Because Pharaoh had beaten the Israelites
Because he found a new well to drink
children-batch4:assu:429.why: Simpler words; follows the BSB wording

children-batch4:assu:43.question: What sad thing did Cain do to his brother Abel in the field?
children-batch4:assu:43.why: Named Cain and Abel; told gently

children-batch4:assu:430.question: What kind of men did Jethro tell Moses to choose as leaders for the people?
children-batch4:assu:430.answer: Men who fear God and can be trusted
wrong: The richest men with the most gold
The tallest and strongest men in camp
The youngest men who could run fastest
children-batch4:assu:430.why: Simpler words, following the BSB; made clear who and what it is about

children-batch4:assu:431.question: Where did the Israelites camp after they left Rephidim?
wrong: On the shore of the Red Sea

children-batch4:assu:432.question: What did God say Israel would be to Him if they obeyed His voice?
children-batch4:assu:432.why: 'Peculiar treasure' changed to the BSB's 'treasured possession'

children-batch4:assu:433.question: What did the people of Israel promise when they heard God's words?
children-batch4:assu:433.answer: "We will do everything the LORD has said."
wrong: "We want to go back to Egypt now."
"We will think about it for a while."
"We will only do some of what He says."
children-batch4:assu:433.why: Took out the King James wording; named the people

children-batch4:assu:434.question: On which mountain did the LORD come down and call Moses to the top?
children-batch4:assu:434.why: Says God gave the law; added wrong choices
children-batch4:assu:434.fixed: The verses show the LORD coming down on Mount Sinai and calling Moses up. They do not show God giving the law, which comes later. The question now asks only what these verses show.

children-batch4:assu:435.question: Where did the people of Israel stand when God came down on Mount Sinai?
children-batch4:assu:435.answer: At the foot of the mountain
wrong: On the very top of the mountain
Back in the land of Egypt
Beside the Nile River in Egypt

children-batch4:assu:436.question: What did Mount Sinai look like when the LORD came down on it?
children-batch4:assu:436.why: Named Mount Sinai and the moment; plain wording

children-batch4:assu:437.question: How many commandments did God give to Israel at Mount Sinai?
children-batch4:assu:437.why: Named Mount Sinai; reference moved to a verse that says 'Ten Commandments'

children-batch4:assu:438.question: What is the first of the Ten Commandments?
children-batch4:assu:438.answer: Have no other gods before Me

children-batch4:assu:439.question: What is the second of the Ten Commandments?
children-batch4:assu:439.answer: Do not make an idol to worship
wrong: Do not steal from your neighbor
Honor your father and your mother
Do not want what others have
children-batch4:assu:439.why: Says which commandments; answer shortened to BSB wording

children-batch4:assu:44.question: How did God punish Cain?
children-batch4:assu:44.answer: His crops would not grow, and he would wander
wrong: He was turned into a tall pillar of salt
He had to build a huge boat by himself
He was sent far away to work in Egypt

children-batch4:assu:440.question: What is the third of the Ten Commandments?
children-batch4:assu:440.answer: Do not misuse the LORD's name
wrong: Do not steal from your neighbor
children-batch4:assu:440.why: Says which commandments; BSB wording, shortened

children-batch4:assu:441.question: What is the fourth of the Ten Commandments?
children-batch4:assu:441.why: Says which commandments; answer shortened to BSB wording; reference widened

children-batch4:assu:442.question: What is the fifth of the Ten Commandments?
children-batch4:assu:442.why: Says which commandments; BSB wording, shortened

children-batch4:assu:443.question: What is the sixth of the Ten Commandments?

children-batch4:assu:444.question: What is the seventh of the Ten Commandments?

children-batch4:assu:445.question: What is the eighth of the Ten Commandments?

children-batch4:assu:446.question: What is the ninth of the Ten Commandments?
children-batch4:assu:446.answer: Do not lie about your neighbor
wrong: Do not steal from your neighbor

children-batch4:assu:447.question: What is the tenth of the Ten Commandments?
children-batch4:assu:447.answer: You shall not covet anything that belongs to your neighbor
wrong: You shall not bear false witness against your neighbor
You shall have no other gods before Me
children-batch4:assu:447.why: Says which commandments; answer shortened to BSB wording

children-batch4:assu:448.question: When the people of Israel saw the thunder and lightning at Mount Sinai, what did they do?

children-batch4:boston:158.question: In Proverbs 23:26, what does the father ask his son to give him?

children-batch4:boston:159.question: In Psalm 51, what does the writer ask God to create in him?

children-batch4:boston:159.fixed: Psalm 51:10 is a prayer asking God to create a clean heart. It does not teach how to 'give our hearts to God', so the question asked something the verse does not say. It now asks what the verse does say.

children-batch4:boston:16.question: Why will God punish sin?
children-batch4:boston:16.answer: He is too pure for evil
wrong: He is in a bad mood
He wants people to be sad
children-batch4:boston:16.why: Changed the KJV-style answer into simple words from the BSB verse.

children-batch4:boston:160.question: What does God promise to do with our hard, sinful hearts?

children-batch4:boston:160.why: Yes-or-no changed to four choices; worded like the verse

children-batch4:boston:161.question: In Proverbs 8, Wisdom speaks like a person. What does Wisdom say about people who love her?

children-batch4:boston:161.fixed: In Proverbs 8 the speaker is Wisdom ("By me kings reign"), not God speaking directly. The question should not say God says it.

children-batch4:boston:162.question: In Proverbs 8, Wisdom speaks like a person. What does Wisdom say will happen to people who look for her early (right away)?
children-batch4:boston:162.why: Made it stand on its own; plain wording
children-batch4:boston:162.fixed: In Proverbs 8 the speaker is Wisdom, not God speaking directly. Also, 'early' is explained for children.

children-batch4:boston:163.question: Besides loving God, what else does God ask us to do?
children-batch4:boston:163.why: Plain words; said what fear means here; added a verse
children-batch4:boston:163.fixed: 'What else should we give him' doesn't fit the answer 'Obey him and fear him'. Keeping the commandments is in verse 13, so the reference now covers both verses.

children-batch4:boston:164.question: Why should we fear God?
children-batch4:boston:164.answer: The LORD is pleased by it
wrong: He wants us to run away
He is never kind to us
children-batch4:boston:164.why: Worded like the verse; added wrong choices

children-batch4:boston:165.question: How can someone who loves God also fear him?
children-batch4:boston:165.answer: They are afraid to do what displeases him

children-batch4:boston:166.question: If we love God, what will we do?

children-batch4:boston:167.question: What is the beginning of wisdom?
children-batch4:boston:167.why: Kept; added wrong choices and BSB 'LORD'

children-batch4:boston:168.dropped: A made-up example about a man who could hurt the child. It is not about any Bible passage, and q15 covers its lesson

children-batch4:boston:169.dropped: Part of the same made-up example about a man. It is not about any Bible passage

children-batch4:boston:17.question: What does the LORD say about whether He changes?
children-batch4:boston:17.why: Made the yes-or-no question into four choices using the verse's words.

children-batch4:boston:170.dropped: Wraps up the made-up example about a man, and q15 already teaches it

children-batch4:boston:171.question: Every good gift comes from God, and Jesus said God can destroy both body and soul in hell. How should we feel toward God?
children-batch4:boston:171.answer: Love him and fear him too
wrong: Only love him, never fear him
Not care about him at all

children-batch4:boston:171.fixed: 'The Judge who can punish sin forever' adds words the verses do not give. Matthew 10:28 says God can destroy soul and body in hell.

children-batch4:boston:172.question: What does the Bible say is the whole duty of man?
children-batch4:boston:172.answer: Fear God and keep His commandments

Build a big house and get rich

children-batch4:boston:173.question: Why did God make people?

children-batch4:boston:175.answer: Treat others how you want to be treated
wrong: Do to others what they did to you

Always take care of yourself first
children-batch4:boston:175.why: Made it about Jesus' words in the verse; the old rhyme dropped

children-batch4:boston:176.question: What did Jesus say to do for people who hate us?
wrong: Tell everyone how bad they are
children-batch4:boston:176.why: Turned into a question about Jesus' teaching on loving enemies

children-batch4:boston:177.question: What does the Bible tell us to do when others are unkind and tease us?
children-batch4:boston:177.answer: Forgive them, as God forgave us
children-batch4:boston:177.why: Old rhyme dropped; tied to the Bible's teaching on forgiving

children-batch4:boston:178.question: When someone calls us bad names, what must we not do?
children-batch4:boston:178.why: 'Hard names' changed to 'bad names'; tied to a verse

children-batch4:boston:179.why: Old rhyme dropped; now asks what the verse says to give back

children-batch4:boston:18.why: Made the wording simpler; kept the catechism word 'unchangeable'.

children-batch4:boston:181.fixed: Colossians 3:12 says nothing about 'people who are hurting'. It tells God's people to put on hearts of compassion and kindness like clothes. The question added something the verse does not say.

children-batch4:boston:182.question: What does Proverbs say a person does when he makes fun of the poor?

children-batch4:boston:183.answer: Cares for them in their trouble

wrong: He was born and will grow old

children-batch4:boston:19.why: Cut the long review list down to one short answer and added references, since no verses were given.

children-batch4:boston:190.question: In 2 Peter 1:21, how did the prophets speak words from God?
children-batch4:boston:190.answer: The Holy Spirit carried them along
wrong: They made the words up themselves

children-batch4:boston:191.question: Where did the men who wrote the Bible get their words?
children-batch4:boston:191.why: Named the Bible writers so it stands alone

children-batch4:boston:193.why: Made into a question about Joshua, with a verse that says he wrote; Moses is asked about in q12

children-batch4:boston:194.why: Yes-or-no question made into four choices, matching 2 Peter 1:21

children-batch4:boston:195.dropped: No Bible passage names the two parts of the Bible 'Old and New Testaments'

children-batch4:boston:196.dropped: No Bible passage gives the number of books in the Old Testament

children-batch4:boston:197.question: What does the very first verse of the Bible teach us?
children-batch4:boston:197.why: The long list of answers cut down to the first point, with a Bible verse

children-batch4:boston:198.question: Who wrote down God's law for the people of Israel?
children-batch4:boston:198.why: Simpler wording; used a verse that says Moses wrote the law

children-batch4:boston:199.dropped: No Bible passage says Ezra wrote the history of the kings; the book only guesses

children-batch4:boston:20.question: After God made the sun, moon and stars, what did He make on the fifth and sixth days?

children-batch4:boston:20.fixed: God did make the stars (Genesis 1:16), so a child could argue that the wrong choice 'Only the stars' is right. The question also leaves out that the stars were made on day four. It now asks about days five and six.

children-batch4:boston:200.question: Which king wrote many psalms, or songs, praising God?
children-batch4:boston:200.why: Gave a Bible verse and simpler words

children-batch4:boston:201.question: Who wrote the wise sayings called proverbs?

children-batch4:boston:202.fixed: Jeremiah 36 is about words the LORD spoke, not visions, and Baruch did the writing while Jeremiah spoke. So 'wrote down the visions' is not right for Jeremiah.

children-batch4:boston:203.question: What did King Darius's men do to Daniel?
children-batch4:boston:203.answer: Threw him into the den of lions
wrong: Put him on a ship at sea
Sent him away to the desert

children-batch4:boston:204.question: What did the angry officials do to Jeremiah?
wrong: Sent him away on a ship

wrong: Because he stole from the king
Because he ran away from home
Because he lied to the king

Because he broke the king's gate

children-batch4:boston:207.why: Named the men so the question stands alone; added a reference

children-batch4:boston:208.answer: A person who tells God's words
wrong: A person who rules a country
A person who builds big houses
children-batch4:boston:208.why: Kept the catechism's teaching, said simply, and tied it to Scripture
children-batch4:boston:208.fixed: The answer was too narrow. Deuteronomy 18:18 says a prophet speaks all the words God puts in his mouth, not only what will happen.

children-batch4:boston:209.dropped: Asks about the child's own wishes, not about what the Bible says

children-batch4:boston:21.why: Took out stones and shells, which the verses do not mention; now asks about plants and trees.

children-batch4:boston:213.why: The Bible doesn't say all four writers knew Jesus, so the question now asks about Luke, which the Bible does tell us

children-batch4:boston:214.question: When Jesus explained Moses and all the Prophets, who did He show they wrote about?

children-batch4:boston:218.question: Who was John the Baptist?
children-batch4:boston:218.answer: A man who got people ready for Jesus

A fisherman who left his nets for Jesus

children-batch4:boston:219.fixed: The verses do not say "the end of the world". Revelation 21:1 shows a new heaven and a new earth after the first ones pass away, so the answer now follows the verse. Acts 1:2 is about the apostles. The wrong choices are all Old Testament stories.

children-batch4:boston:221.why: Uses the BSB name Paul and says which letters are meant.

children-batch4:boston:225.answer: He died for the sins of the world

children-batch4:boston:226.question: What does the Bible tell us about how the world began?
children-batch4:boston:226.why: The printed answer was a rhyme, so the question now asks about its first line: how the world was made.

children-batch4:boston:227.answer: The Holy Spirit carried them along
wrong: Kings told them what to write

children-batch4:boston:228.question: In the book of Revelation, what will God take away from anyone who takes away from its words?

wrong: Their house and all of their land

Their friends and all of their family

children-batch4:boston:229.answer: The plagues written in that book
children-batch4:boston:229.why: Old wording made plainer, and the question now stands on its own.

children-batch4:boston:234.why: Says that God is the one making; added choices

children-batch4:boston:240.why: Made a full sentence; added choices

children-batch4:boston:243.question: How did Adam and Eve disobey God?
children-batch4:boston:243.answer: They ate from the tree God told them not to

They forgot to name the animals God had made

children-batch4:boston:843.why: Named Jesus and put 'agony' into simple words

children-batch4:boston:844.question: In the garden, what did Jesus tell His disciples about how He felt?
children-batch4:boston:844.answer: His soul was full of sorrow
wrong: He was not worried at all
children-batch4:boston:844.why: The verses do not give the printed reason, so I asked what Jesus said about His sorrow

children-batch4:boston:845.question: What did Jesus first ask His Father in Gethsemane?
children-batch4:boston:845.answer: To let this cup pass from Him
wrong: To send Him a golden crown
To give Him a big army
To let Him go home to Nazareth
children-batch4:boston:845.why: Named Jesus and the place, and used the BSB words

children-batch4:boston:846.question: After asking for the cup to be taken away, what did Jesus say to His Father?
children-batch4:boston:846.why: Changed from yes or no to four choices, using the BSB words

children-batch4:boston:847.question: When Jesus prayed hard in the garden, what did His sweat become like?
children-batch4:boston:847.answer: Drops of blood on the ground
wrong: Drops of rain from the sky
children-batch4:boston:847.why: Named Jesus; used the BSB wording 'like drops of blood' and told it gently

children-batch4:boston:848.question: Who came from heaven to give Jesus strength while He prayed in the garden?
children-batch4:boston:848.why: Named Jesus; changed 'comfort' to 'strengthen' to match the BSB

children-batch4:boston:849.question: The Bible says Jesus suffered for sins. Who did He suffer for?
children-batch4:boston:849.answer: Sinners, to bring them to God
wrong: Only for the angels in heaven
children-batch4:boston:849.why: Changed a question about the child's own life into a question about what Scripture teaches; reference added

children-batch4:boston:85.question: When God looked at everything He had made, Adam and Eve too, what did He see it was?
children-batch4:boston:85.why: Changed from a this-or-that question to the words of Genesis 1:31

children-batch4:boston:850.question: Where were Jesus' disciples while He prayed in the garden of Gethsemane?
children-batch4:boston:850.why: Named the disciples and the place; made it multiple choice

children-batch4:boston:851.question: Which of the Twelve was not with Jesus in the garden, but came later with a big crowd?
children-batch4:boston:851.why: Changed a yes-or-no question to one that asks which disciple; named Judas

children-batch4:boston:852.question: What did Judas do when he came to the garden?
children-batch4:boston:852.answer: Brought a crowd and kissed Jesus
children-batch4:boston:852.why: Named Judas; kept to what the verses say

children-batch4:boston:853.question: How did Judas show the crowd which man was Jesus?
children-batch4:boston:853.why: Made the question shorter and gentler

children-batch4:boston:854.question: When Judas came near to kiss Jesus, what did Jesus ask him?
children-batch4:boston:854.answer: "Judas, are you betraying the Son of Man with a kiss?"
wrong: "Will you stay and pray with Me?"
children-batch4:boston:854.why: Changed a yes-or-no question to ask what Jesus said; used the BSB quote
children-batch4:boston:854.fixed: The answer was put in quotation marks but changed Jesus' words ('the Son of Man' became 'Me'). Also, in Luke, Jesus asks this as Judas comes near to kiss Him. The verse does not say Judas had already kissed Him.

children-batch4:boston:855.question: What did Jesus' disciples ask when they saw the crowd coming to take Him?
children-batch4:boston:855.answer: "Lord, should we strike with our swords?"
wrong: "Lord, should we hide in the trees?"

children-batch4:boston:856.question: What did Jesus answer when His disciples asked about using their swords?
children-batch4:boston:856.why: Said who is answering; used the BSB words in place of the King James words

children-batch4:boston:857.question: When the men came to arrest Jesus in the garden, what did Simon Peter do with his sword?
children-batch4:boston:857.answer: Cut off the right ear of the high priest's servant
children-batch4:boston:857.why: Named Peter, as John does; told gently
children-batch4:boston:857.fixed: "Before Jesus answered" only makes sense after the question before it. In John's account nobody asks Jesus a question here. The fixed question says when and where this happened.

children-batch4:boston:858.question: What did Jesus do for the servant whose ear was cut off?
children-batch4:boston:858.answer: Touched his ear and healed him
wrong: Ran away from him in fear
children-batch4:boston:858.why: Named the servant being healed; added the touch from the verse

children-batch4:boston:859.question: Jesus healed the ear of the high priest's servant, who was with the people who came to arrest Him. What does this show about Jesus?
children-batch4:boston:859.answer: He was kind to His enemies
wrong: He wanted to fight the crowd
He was afraid of the crowd
He wanted His disciple to be punished
children-batch4:boston:859.why: Changed a 'what if' yes-or-no question into one about what the healing shows
children-batch4:boston:859.fixed: A wrong choice named Peter, but these verses in Luke only say 'one of them' struck the servant. I changed it so it does not add a name the verses do not give.

children-batch4:boston:86.question: How did God make Adam and Eve?
wrong: In the image of the animals
In the image of the stars
In the image of the trees
children-batch4:boston:86.why: Changed from 'what do you think' to a fact the verses give (made in God's image)

children-batch4:boston:860.question: What does Jesus healing the servant teach us to do?
children-batch4:boston:860.answer: Do good to those who hurt us
wrong: Pay back those who hurt us
children-batch4:boston:860.why: Said what the lesson is about; added the verse where Jesus teaches it

children-batch4:boston:861.question: Where did the men who arrested Jesus take Him?
children-batch4:boston:861.answer: To the house of Caiaphas the high priest
wrong: To a boat on the sea
To the top of a mountain
children-batch4:boston:861.why: Named who led Jesus and gave Caiaphas's name

children-batch4:boston:862.question: Which disciples followed Jesus to the high priest's house?
children-batch4:boston:862.why: Named Jesus and the place; the verses say 'another disciple', not John

children-batch4:boston:863.question: Which disciple told a servant girl that he did not know what she was talking about when she said he had been with Jesus?
children-batch4:boston:863.why: Dropped 'afraid', which the verses do not say; named who asked Peter

children-batch4:boston:864.question: How many times did Peter say he did not know Jesus?

children-batch4:boston:865.question: What had Jesus told Peter would happen before the rooster crowed?
children-batch4:boston:865.answer: Peter would deny Him three times
wrong: Peter would walk on the water
Peter would become a great king
Peter would build a new temple
children-batch4:boston:865.why: Yes-or-no question changed to four choices

children-batch4:boston:866.question: What did Peter do after he said three times that he did not know Jesus?
children-batch4:boston:866.answer: He went outside and cried hard
wrong: He went home and fell asleep
He ran off to tell Pilate
He sang a happy little song

children-batch4:boston:867.question: What had Peter done when he said he did not know Jesus?

children-batch4:boston:868.dropped: Asks what we suppose; the verses do not say why Peter denied Jesus, so the answer is a guess

children-batch4:boston:869.question: What did the men holding Jesus do to Him at the high priest's house?
children-batch4:boston:869.answer: Covered His eyes and made fun of Him
wrong: Gave Him a big feast to eat
Let Him go home to His family
Bowed down to worship Him as King
children-batch4:boston:869.why: Named who did it; told gently

children-batch4:boston:87.question: What does the Bible tell children to do?
children-batch4:boston:87.answer: Obey their parents in the Lord
wrong: Obey only when they want to
children-batch4:boston:87.why: Changed from a 'what if' about the child to what Ephesians 6:1 tells children to do

children-batch4:boston:870.question: What did the men keep saying to Jesus after they covered His eyes?
children-batch4:boston:870.why: Quoted the BSB words; named who spoke

children-batch4:boston:871.question: When the chief priests and leaders met with Jesus in the morning, what did they all ask Him?
children-batch4:boston:871.answer: "Are You then the Son of God?"
children-batch4:boston:871.fixed: 'The leaders' was too vague. The question now names who they were (the council of chief priests, scribes and elders, 22:66) and when they asked.

children-batch4:boston:872.question: What did Jesus answer when the leaders asked if He was the Son of God?
children-batch4:boston:872.why: Used BSB wording; question stands on its own

children-batch4:boston:873.question: What did the chief priests and elders do with Jesus when morning came?
children-batch4:boston:873.answer: Tied Him up and took Him to Pilate
wrong: Untied Him and let Him go free
Made Him the king of their people
Sent Him back to His home in Galilee
children-batch4:boston:873.why: Fixed to BSB (bound, not irons); named who did it

children-batch4:boston:874.question: Who was the governor that Jesus was taken to?

children-batch4:boston:875.question: What did Pilate do with Jesus when he learned Jesus was from Herod's land?

children-batch4:boston:876.question: What did Herod and his soldiers do to Jesus?
children-batch4:boston:876.why: Plain words; added Herod's soldiers as the verse says

children-batch4:boston:877.question: Who was the Herod that Pilate sent Jesus to?
children-batch4:boston:877.why: The Bible does not say he was the son of the first Herod; asks what land he ruled instead

children-batch4:boston:878.question: Why did Pilate send Jesus to Herod?
children-batch4:boston:878.answer: Jesus was from Galilee, where Herod ruled
wrong: Jesus asked to go see Herod
children-batch4:boston:878.why: Named Pilate, Jesus and Herod; simpler words

children-batch4:boston:879.question: How did Herod and his soldiers treat Jesus?
children-batch4:boston:879.why: Simpler words; made it plain who acted; added choices

children-batch4:boston:88.question: What two trees were in the middle of the garden of Eden?
children-batch4:boston:88.answer: The tree of life and the tree of the knowledge of good and evil
wrong: A fig tree and an olive tree
A palm tree and a cedar tree
An oak tree and a pine tree
children-batch4:boston:88.why: Took out the teacher's opening words and used the BSB names for the trees

children-batch4:boston:880.question: After Herod made fun of Jesus, where did he send Him?
children-batch4:boston:880.why: Made it stand on its own; dropped 'governor of Judea', which the verse does not say

children-batch4:boston:881.question: What did Pilate tell the crowd about Jesus after Herod sent Him back?
children-batch4:boston:881.answer: He is not guilty of what you said
wrong: He must be put to death right away
He is a thief who stole money
He should be made your new king
children-batch4:boston:881.why: Gentler wording; answer follows the BSB
children-batch4:boston:881.fixed: The wrong choice 'He must be punished' is also right, because Pilate said 'I will punish Him and release Him' (23:16). Also, Pilate said Jesus was not guilty of their charges and had done nothing deserving death. That is not quite the same as 'nothing wrong'.

children-batch4:boston:882.question: What did Pilate want to do with Jesus?

children-batch4:boston:883.question: What did the crowd keep shouting when Pilate wanted to let Jesus go?
children-batch4:boston:883.why: Changed 'the Jews' to the crowd; made it stand on its own

children-batch4:boston:884.question: What does it mean to crucify someone?
children-batch4:boston:884.answer: To put someone to death on a cross
wrong: To put someone in jail for a while
To send someone far away from home
To crown someone as the new king
children-batch4:boston:884.why: Said simply and gently; added a reference

children-batch4:boston:885.question: What did Pilate do in front of the crowd to show he did not want the blame for Jesus' death?
children-batch4:boston:885.why: Yes-or-no question made into four choices; 'Do as you please' is not in the BSB

children-batch4:boston:886.question: When Pilate said he was not to blame for Jesus' death, what did the people answer?
children-batch4:boston:886.why: Changed 'the Jews' to the people; made it stand on its own; said gently

children-batch4:boston:887.question: What did the governor's soldiers put on Jesus?
children-batch4:boston:887.why: Focused on the robe; named the soldiers; gentle wording

children-batch4:boston:888.question: What did the soldiers put on Jesus' head?

children-batch4:boston:889.question: What did the soldiers put in Jesus' right hand?
children-batch4:boston:889.why: Used the BSB word 'staff'; named the soldiers

children-batch4:boston:89.question: Which tree in the garden did God tell Adam not to eat from?
children-batch4:boston:89.answer: The tree of the knowledge of good and evil
children-batch4:boston:89.why: Reworded so it makes sense alone; used the BSB name for the tree

children-batch4:boston:890.question: Why did the soldiers put a scarlet robe and a crown of thorns on Jesus?
children-batch4:boston:890.answer: To make fun of Him as a king
wrong: To honor Him as a real king
To keep Him warm in the cold
To hide who He was from people

children-batch4:boston:891.question: What did kings in Bible times wear on their heads?
children-batch4:boston:891.why: Yes-or-no question made into four choices; added a reference

children-batch4:boston:892.question: What did the soldiers say to Jesus when they knelt down before Him?
children-batch4:boston:892.why: Named the soldiers and Jesus; used the BSB words 'Hail, King of the Jews!'

children-batch4:boston:893.question: Why did the soldiers kneel down before Jesus and call Him king?
children-batch4:boston:893.why: Named who and what; asked why they did it, in plain words

children-batch4:boston:894.question: After the soldiers made fun of Jesus as king, what did they do to Him next?
children-batch4:boston:894.answer: They spit on Him and hit His head
wrong: They washed His feet and gave bread
They let Him go home to rest
They gave Him a gold crown
children-batch4:boston:894.why: Replaced 'indignity'; named the soldiers; matched the BSB 'staff'; told gently
children-batch4:boston:894.fixed: "What else" only makes sense after the question before it, and "to be unkind" makes what the soldiers did sound smaller than it was. The question now says when this happened, so it makes sense by itself.

children-batch4:boston:895.question: Where did the soldiers take Jesus to crucify Him?
children-batch4:boston:895.answer: Golgotha, the Place of the Skull
children-batch4:boston:895.why: Named Jesus; changed Calvary to the BSB's Golgotha
children-batch4:boston:895.fixed: The soldiers also took Jesus into the Praetorium (Matthew 27:27), so the question did not say which place it meant. Now it asks where they took Him to be crucified.

children-batch4:boston:896.question: Who followed Jesus as He was led away?
children-batch4:boston:896.why: Named Jesus; used the BSB's 'great number of people'

children-batch4:boston:897.question: Who in the crowd was crying and mourning for Jesus?
children-batch4:boston:897.why: Repeated q5, so it now asks who was crying for Jesus

children-batch4:boston:898.question: What did Jesus tell the women of Jerusalem who were crying for Him?
wrong: "Go and find My disciples for Me."
children-batch4:boston:898.why: Named the women; used the BSB words
children-batch4:boston:898.fixed: The wrong choice "Do not be sad, I'm fine." is too close to what Jesus really said ("do not weep for Me"), so a child could think it is partly right. I put in a choice that is clearly wrong.

children-batch4:boston:899.question: Why did Jesus tell the women to cry for themselves and their children?
children-batch4:boston:899.answer: Hard days of trouble were coming
wrong: They had lost their way home
He wanted to be left alone
children-batch4:boston:899.why: Simpler words; named Jesus and the women

children-batch4:boston:9.question: When does God know what you are going to say?
children-batch4:boston:9.why: Made the yes-or-no question into four choices about what the verse says.

children-batch4:boston:90.question: What did God say would happen if Adam ate from the tree of the knowledge of good and evil?
wrong: He would fall asleep for a year
children-batch4:boston:90.why: Named the tree and Adam so it makes sense alone

children-batch4:boston:900.question: Jesus told the women of Jerusalem not to cry for Him. Who did He tell them to cry for instead?
children-batch4:boston:900.why: Answer now matches the verses: the women of Jerusalem and their children, not 'the Jews'
children-batch4:boston:900.fixed: The answer said the children should cry. Jesus told the women to cry for themselves and for their children, so the crying belongs to the women.

children-batch4:boston:901.question: Why did Jesus say trouble would come to Jerusalem?
children-batch4:boston:901.answer: They missed God's visit to them
wrong: They had built too many houses
They did not have a king
children-batch4:boston:901.why: These verses don't give the reason, so it now uses Jesus' own words in Luke 19:44 and doesn't blame a whole people

children-batch4:boston:902.question: What was Jesus put on to die?
children-batch4:boston:902.why: Simpler words; the reference changed to verses that name the cross

children-batch4:boston:903.question: Who was crucified on each side of Jesus?
children-batch4:boston:903.why: Changed 'thief' to the BSB's 'robbers'; answer made complete

children-batch4:boston:904.question: Two robbers were crucified next to Jesus. What does a robber do?
children-batch4:boston:904.answer: Takes things that are not theirs
children-batch4:boston:904.why: Changed to the BSB's 'robber' and linked to the story; the reference is a verse about stealing

children-batch4:boston:905.question: What did the soldiers offer Jesus to drink?
children-batch4:boston:905.why: Named the soldiers; fixed the answer to the BSB's 'wine mixed with gall'

children-batch4:boston:906.question: What did Jesus do after He tasted the wine mixed with gall?
wrong: He gave it to the robbers
children-batch4:boston:906.why: The verse doesn't say how gall tastes, so it now asks what Jesus did, which the verse does say

children-batch4:boston:907.question: Jesus tasted the wine mixed with gall. What did He do next?
wrong: He gave it to a soldier
children-batch4:boston:907.why: Named Jesus and the drink; made into a choice question

children-batch4:boston:908.question: What did Jesus pray for the people who put Him on the cross?
children-batch4:boston:908.why: Named Jesus; answer uses His prayer from the verse

children-batch4:boston:909.question: Jesus prayed for the people who hurt Him. What does this teach us to do for people who hurt us?
children-batch4:boston:909.answer: Forgive them and pray for them
children-batch4:boston:909.why: Made it stand alone; simpler words

children-batch4:boston:91.question: What did Eve and Adam do with the fruit God told them not to eat?
wrong: They gave it to the animals
children-batch4:boston:91.why: Changed from a yes-or-no question to one with four choices

children-batch4:boston:910.question: What came over all the land while Jesus was on the cross?
children-batch4:boston:910.why: Dropped the 'three hours' timing, which the verse does not give

children-batch4:boston:911.question: How long was it dark over the land while Jesus was on the cross?
children-batch4:boston:911.why: Named the darkness at the cross

children-batch4:boston:912.question: What happened to the sun while Jesus was on the cross?
children-batch4:boston:912.why: Answer is from Luke, since Matthew 27:45 does not say how dark it was

children-batch4:boston:913.question: At what time of day did it get dark while Jesus was on the cross?
children-batch4:boston:913.answer: From noon until three in the afternoon
wrong: From midnight until three in the morning
From six until nine at night
children-batch4:boston:913.why: Named the event; put the sixth to ninth hour in today's clock times

children-batch4:boston:914.question: What did the earth do when Jesus died?
children-batch4:boston:914.why: Made it a gentle question about the earth

children-batch4:boston:915.question: What happened to the rocks and tombs when the earth quaked as Jesus died?
children-batch4:boston:915.answer: Rocks split and tombs broke open

children-batch4:boston:916.question: When the tombs broke open, what happened to many of God's people who had died?
wrong: They were carried away by wind
children-batch4:boston:916.why: Matched the BSB: many saints were raised

children-batch4:boston:917.question: What happened to the veil of the temple when Jesus died?
children-batch4:boston:917.answer: It tore in two, top to bottom
wrong: It was burned up in a fire
It was folded and put away
children-batch4:boston:917.why: BSB spelling 'veil'; answer from the verse

children-batch4:boston:918.question: What was the veil of the temple?
children-batch4:boston:918.answer: A curtain before the Most Holy Place
wrong: The big front door of the temple
A robe the high priest wore
children-batch4:boston:918.why: Answer from Exodus, since Matthew does not say what the veil was

children-batch4:boston:919.question: How did the centurion and the soldiers guarding Jesus feel when they saw the earthquake?
children-batch4:boston:919.why: Made it about the guarding soldiers and their fear, as in the BSB verse

children-batch4:boston:92.question: What lie did the serpent tell Eve to get her to disobey God?
wrong: "God will give you more fruit tomorrow"
children-batch4:boston:92.why: Named the serpent as the verses do and asked what lie he told

children-batch4:boston:920.question: What did the centurion and the soldiers guarding Jesus say after the earthquake?

children-batch4:boston:921.question: The next day was a special Sabbath. What did the Jews ask Pilate to do with the bodies on the crosses?
wrong: Leave them up for the Sabbath
children-batch4:boston:921.why: Matched the BSB: they asked Pilate to remove the bodies; told gently

children-batch4:boston:922.question: What did the soldiers do to the two men crucified beside Jesus?
children-batch4:boston:922.why: Named who, dropped 'to make them die', told gently

children-batch4:boston:923.question: Why did the soldiers not break Jesus' legs?
children-batch4:boston:923.why: Yes/no made multiple choice; BSB says legs, not bones

children-batch4:boston:924.question: What did one of the soldiers do to Jesus' side?
children-batch4:boston:924.why: Removed 'wicked' (not in verse), named Jesus' side

children-batch4:boston:925.question: What flowed out when the soldier pierced Jesus' side?

children-batch4:boston:926.question: How should we feel toward Jesus, who suffered so much for us?
children-batch4:boston:926.answer: Love Him with all our hearts
wrong: Be afraid and hide from Him
Feel nothing for Him at all
children-batch4:boston:926.why: Kept teaching, simpler words, added Scripture

children-batch4:boston:927.question: Who went to Pilate and asked for the body of Jesus?

children-batch4:boston:928.question: What did Joseph do with the body of Jesus?
children-batch4:boston:928.answer: Put it in his new tomb
children-batch4:boston:928.why: Named Joseph; matched BSB 'his own new tomb'

children-batch4:boston:929.question: Who brought spices and helped Joseph bury Jesus?
children-batch4:boston:929.why: Changed to match John: Nicodemus helped bury Jesus

children-batch4:boston:93.question: Why does the Bible say children should obey their parents?
wrong: Because they will get a prize
children-batch4:boston:93.why: Changed from a yes-or-no question to the reason Ephesians 6:1 gives

children-batch4:boston:930.question: What did Joseph roll across the entrance of Jesus' tomb?

children-batch4:boston:931.question: What did the chief priests and Pharisees do to make Jesus' tomb secure?
children-batch4:boston:931.answer: Sealed the stone and posted guards
children-batch4:boston:931.why: Named the chief priests and Pharisees; matched BSB

children-batch4:boston:932.question: Why did the chief priests want soldiers to guard Jesus' tomb?
children-batch4:boston:932.answer: So the disciples couldn't take His body
wrong: So robbers couldn't steal any gold
So Pilate could come and visit it
So the big stone wouldn't crack

children-batch4:boston:933.question: What did the women do on the Sabbath while Jesus lay in the tomb?
wrong: They went fishing on the lake
children-batch4:boston:933.why: Night count isn't in the verses; asked what they give

children-batch4:boston:934.question: Who came down from heaven to Jesus' tomb early on the first day of the week?
wrong: A white dove from the sky
children-batch4:boston:934.why: Matched BSB: angel came down from heaven at dawn

children-batch4:boston:935.question: What did the angel do to the stone at Jesus' tomb?
children-batch4:boston:935.why: Named the angel and the stone

children-batch4:boston:936.question: After rolling away the stone, what did the angel do?

children-batch4:boston:937.question: What did the angel tell the women about Jesus at the tomb?
children-batch4:boston:937.answer: He is not here; He has risen
wrong: He is still asleep inside the tomb
He went to live in Egypt
children-batch4:boston:937.why: Old answer isn't in these verses; reworded to match the angel's words
children-batch4:boston:937.fixed: The question asks 'where', but the answer is not a place. Also, the wrong choice 'Sitting on top of the stone' is what the angel did (28:2), which could mix children up. The new question asks what the angel told the women.

children-batch4:boston:938.question: What happened to the guards at Jesus' tomb when the angel came?
children-batch4:boston:938.answer: They shook and became like dead men
wrong: They laughed and sang happy songs
They pulled swords and fought the angel
They rolled the big stone back
children-batch4:boston:938.why: Named the guards; answer now follows the BSB

children-batch4:boston:939.question: Who went to see Jesus' tomb at dawn on the first day of the week?
children-batch4:boston:939.answer: Mary Magdalene and the other Mary
children-batch4:boston:939.why: Named the women as the BSB does
children-batch4:boston:939.fixed: The answer is right, but the wrong choice "Peter and John" could also be argued as right. John 20:1-4 says Peter and the other disciple ran to the tomb early that same morning. I replaced it with a choice that is clearly wrong.

children-batch4:boston:94.question: What does the Bible say God made people to be at the very start?
children-batch4:boston:94.why: Changed from a yes-or-no question to what God made people at the start; Ecclesiastes 7:29 gives this

children-batch4:boston:940.question: What did Mary Magdalene think when she saw the stone moved away from Jesus' tomb?
children-batch4:boston:940.answer: That someone had taken Jesus away
wrong: That she had found the wrong tomb
