children-batch4:boyce:94.why: Asked what freedom from sin leads to, from Romans 6:22

children-batch4:boyce:95.question: Can we become perfectly holy, with no sin at all, while we live in this life?
wrong: Yes, as soon as we are baptized
Yes, if we try hard enough
children-batch4:boyce:95.why: Named the topic (being perfectly holy) so it stands alone; four choices

children-batch4:boyce:96.question: What is the Holy Spirit doing in God's people as they are made holy?
children-batch4:boyce:96.answer: Changing us to be more like the Lord
wrong: Making us perfect all in one day
Leaving us just the way we were
Making us rich and famous forever
children-batch4:boyce:96.why: Simpler words; tied to the verse's being changed into the Lord's image by the Spirit

children-batch4:boyce:97.question: What is repentance?
children-batch4:boyce:97.answer: Being sorry for sin and turning to God
wrong: Saying sorry only to get out of trouble
Being sad about a broken toy
Hiding our sin so no one finds out
children-batch4:boyce:97.why: Simple wording; added a verse that shows repentance as turning from sin

children-batch4:boyce:98.question: What does the Bible say about being sorry for sin?
children-batch4:boyce:98.answer: Godly sorrow leads to true repentance
wrong: Every sad feeling is true repentance
We never need to be sorry for sin
children-batch4:boyce:98.why: Yes/no question turned into four choices using the verse

children-batch4:boyce:99.question: If someone is sorry only because they are afraid of being caught or punished, is that true repentance?
children-batch4:boyce:99.answer: No, it is not true repentance
wrong: Yes, it is always true repentance
Yes, if they cry a lot
Yes, if a grown-up saw it
children-batch4:boyce:99.why: Made it a full question with four choices

children-batch4:little:1.question: Who made you?
children-batch4:little:1.why: Made it simpler; changed the reference to a verse that says God made us

children-batch4:little:10.question: What did God make on the third day?
children-batch4:little:10.why: Answer fixed to the verses: God gathered the waters so dry land appeared, and He made plants.

children-batch4:little:100.question: When Jesus was born, what did the many angels say as they praised God in front of the shepherds?
children-batch4:little:100.why: Named the angels; BSB says 'saying' not 'sing'; BSB wording of the praise
children-batch4:little:100.fixed: The question doesn't say which angels it means. It now names the angels who came to the shepherds when Jesus was born.

children-batch4:little:101.question: When Jesus was born, God's bright glory shone and many angels came to tell about Him. What did that show about Jesus?
children-batch4:little:101.answer: That He is very great, the Savior and Lord
wrong: That He was just an ordinary baby
That He would grow up to be a shepherd
That He was just another angel
children-batch4:little:101.why: Simpler words; named the shining glory and angels
children-batch4:little:101.fixed: The teaching is right: the Lord's glory and a great crowd of angels came to tell about the Savior, Christ the Lord. But the long question with 'glorious' in it is hard for young children, so it is now said more simply.

children-batch4:little:102.question: When God brought His Son into the world, what did He tell all His angels to do?
children-batch4:little:102.why: Asked what the given verse says, keeping the teaching that Jesus is great

children-batch4:little:103.question: Where did the shepherds go after the angels left them?

children-batch4:little:104.question: Who did the shepherds find in Bethlehem?
children-batch4:little:104.why: Named the shepherds and Bethlehem; BSB wording

children-batch4:little:105.question: Where was baby Jesus lying when the shepherds found Him?
children-batch4:little:105.why: Named baby Jesus and the shepherds

children-batch4:little:106.question: Baby Jesus was laid in a manger. What is a manger?
children-batch4:little:106.answer: A box that animals eat from
wrong: A soft bed inside a house
A little boat on the water

children-batch4:little:107.question: After the shepherds saw baby Jesus, what did they tell people?
children-batch4:little:107.answer: The message they heard about Jesus
wrong: That they had lost their sheep
That a big storm was coming
children-batch4:little:107.why: Matched BSB: they spread the message about Him

children-batch4:little:108.question: How did people feel when they heard what the shepherds said?

children-batch4:little:109.question: When the shepherds told people about baby Jesus, what were the people amazed at?
children-batch4:little:109.why: Yes-or-no changed to ask what the people were amazed at
children-batch4:little:109.fixed: The question did not say which people or what story it was about.

children-batch4:little:11.question: What did God make on the fourth day?

children-batch4:little:110.question: What did Mary, the mother of Jesus, do with everything that happened when baby Jesus was born, and what the shepherds told?
children-batch4:little:110.answer: She kept them in her heart
wrong: She ran and told King Herod
She laughed at all of them
children-batch4:little:110.fixed: 'All these things' was vague. The question did not say what things were meant.

children-batch4:little:111.question: The Bible says Mary 'pondered' these things in her heart. What does that mean?

children-batch4:little:112.question: What did the shepherds do after they had seen Jesus?
children-batch4:little:112.why: BSB spelling 'Savior'; named Jesus; added choices

children-batch4:little:113.question: Why should we praise God like the shepherds did?
children-batch4:little:113.answer: Because Jesus is our Savior too
children-batch4:little:113.why: Simpler words; kept the catechism teaching

children-batch4:little:114.question: Besides the shepherds, who came to see Jesus?
wrong: Soldiers from the city of Rome
Fishermen from the Sea of Galilee

children-batch4:little:115.question: What did the wise men see in the east?
children-batch4:little:115.answer: The star of the newborn King
wrong: A bright rainbow in the clouds
An angel flying in the sky
A big fire on a hill
children-batch4:little:115.why: Named the wise men; made the answer clearer; added choices

children-batch4:little:116.question: What did the star do for the wise men?
children-batch4:little:116.answer: It led them to where Jesus was
wrong: It fell down from the sky
It went away and was never seen
It turned them back toward home
children-batch4:little:116.why: Named the star and the wise men; simpler words

children-batch4:little:117.question: How did the wise men feel when they saw the star?
children-batch4:little:117.why: Named the wise men; took out the King James wording

children-batch4:little:118.question: How did the wise men know where to find the Child Jesus?
children-batch4:little:118.answer: The star stopped right over the place
wrong: A shepherd showed them the way
They saw a sign on the door
children-batch4:little:118.why: Used 'the Child Jesus' as the BSB does; simpler words

children-batch4:little:119.question: What did the wise men do when they found the Child Jesus?
children-batch4:little:119.answer: They bowed down and worshiped Him
wrong: They sang Him a happy song
They took Him back to their home
They gave Him a brand new name
children-batch4:little:119.why: Named the wise men and Jesus

children-batch4:little:12.question: What did God make on the fifth day?
children-batch4:little:12.why: Answer worded as the BSB has it (sea creatures).

children-batch4:little:120.question: What gifts did the wise men give to Jesus?
children-batch4:little:120.why: Named who gave and who got the gifts

children-batch4:little:121.question: What kind of gifts were the frankincense and myrrh that the wise men gave Jesus?
children-batch4:little:121.why: Matthew does not say what they are, so the answer now comes from Exodus 30, which calls them sweet-smelling spices; left out 'gums from trees'

children-batch4:little:122.question: How did the wise men show honor to Jesus?
children-batch4:little:122.answer: They worshiped Him and gave Him gifts
wrong: They made Him a king's crown
They built Him a big house
They wrote a song about Him
children-batch4:little:122.why: Changed the yes-or-no question to one with choices

children-batch4:little:123.question: What does God say all His angels should do to Jesus?
children-batch4:little:123.why: Changed the yes-or-no question to one with choices, using the verse's words

children-batch4:little:124.question: God's angels worship Jesus. What should we do?
children-batch4:little:124.why: Changed the yes-or-no question to one with choices; kept the teaching that we should worship Christ

children-batch4:little:125.question: After the wise men (the Magi) left, who came to Joseph in a dream?
children-batch4:little:125.why: Used 'Magi' as the BSB does, with 'wise men' too; added the dream

children-batch4:little:126.question: What did the angel tell Joseph to do?
wrong: Go and find the wise men
children-batch4:little:126.why: Named the angel and Joseph; changed the answer to the BSB's words 'Get up' and 'flee' (the verse does not say Judea)

children-batch4:little:127.question: Where did the angel tell Joseph to go?

children-batch4:little:128.question: Whom did Joseph take with him to Egypt?
wrong: The wise men and their camels
children-batch4:little:128.why: Named Joseph; called Jesus' mother Mary, as Matthew 2:11 does

children-batch4:little:129.question: Why did the angel tell Joseph to take Jesus to Egypt?
children-batch4:little:129.answer: To keep Jesus safe from Herod
wrong: To meet the wise men again
children-batch4:little:129.why: Named Joseph and Herod; told it gently

children-batch4:little:13.question: What did God make on the sixth day?
children-batch4:little:13.answer: Animals that live on the land
children-batch4:little:13.why: Named God instead of 'He'; took out horses, cows and sheep, which the verses don't name.

children-batch4:little:130.question: Who wanted to kill the Child Jesus?
children-batch4:little:130.why: Named Jesus so it stands alone; added choices.
children-batch4:little:130.fixed: The verses call Jesus 'the Child,' and by this time the family was living in a house. Calling Him a 'baby' adds something the verses do not say. The question now says 'the Child Jesus,' as the other questions do.

children-batch4:little:131.question: After King Herod died, where did Joseph take Jesus and Mary?
children-batch4:little:131.answer: Back to the land of Israel
wrong: Deeper into the land of Egypt
Far away to the land of Babylon
Across the big sea to Rome
children-batch4:little:131.why: The old answer (Judea) disagrees with the verses; Joseph went back to the land of Israel.

children-batch4:little:132.question: In what town did Jesus live when He was a boy?
children-batch4:little:132.why: Added 'as a boy' to make it clear; added choices.

children-batch4:little:133.question: How long did Jesus live in the town of Nazareth?
children-batch4:little:133.why: Named Jesus and Nazareth; added a verse that holds the answer.

children-batch4:little:134.question: In what land was the town of Nazareth?

children-batch4:little:135.dropped: No passage says if Nazareth was large or small. John 1:46 only shows Nathanael thought little of the town.

children-batch4:little:136.question: Who came preaching in the wilderness to get the way ready for Jesus?
children-batch4:little:136.why: Put 'beforehand' in a child's words, using the verses.

children-batch4:little:137.question: What were John the Baptist's clothes made of?

children-batch4:little:138.question: What did John the Baptist eat?
children-batch4:little:138.why: Named John the Baptist so it stands alone.

children-batch4:little:139.question: What did John the Baptist tell the people to do?
children-batch4:little:139.why: Named John the Baptist; used the verse's word 'repent'.

children-batch4:little:14.question: Besides the animals, what else did God make on the sixth day?
children-batch4:little:14.answer: Man and woman, in God's image
wrong: The stars that shine at night
The great creatures of the sea
The dry land and the seas
children-batch4:little:14.why: Named God; added 'in God's image' and male and female, as the verses say.

children-batch4:little:140.question: What did John the Baptist do for the people in the Jordan River?
children-batch4:little:140.why: Named John the Baptist and the Jordan River.

children-batch4:little:141.question: Why did Jesus come to John at the Jordan River?
children-batch4:little:141.why: Changed the yes-or-no question to one with four choices.

children-batch4:little:142.question: Why did Jesus say He should be baptized?
children-batch4:little:142.answer: To do everything that is right
wrong: To wash off dust from the road
children-batch4:little:142.why: The verse does not say 'for an example'; used Jesus' own reason from the verse.

children-batch4:little:143.question: When Jesus sent His followers to make disciples of all nations, what did He tell them to do to the new disciples?
children-batch4:little:143.why: Changed the yes-or-no question to one with four choices, using Jesus' command.

children-batch4:little:144.question: Jesus told His followers to baptize people. In whose name did He tell them to baptize?
wrong: The high priest and the elders
children-batch4:little:144.why: Kept the catechism's teaching; changed 'Holy Ghost' to 'Holy Spirit'; simpler words.
children-batch4:little:144.fixed: The answer says baptism is 'going under water.' The verses only say Jesus 'went up out of the water.' They never say anyone went under it, so this adds something the verses do not give, about a matter Christians disagree on. The fixed question asks what Matthew 28:19 says plainly: the name people are baptized in.

children-batch4:little:145.question: When Ananias told Saul to get up and be baptized, what did he say would be washed away?
children-batch4:little:145.why: Tied to Acts 22:16 and named Ananias and Saul; simpler words

children-batch4:little:146.question: What cleans us from all sin?
children-batch4:little:146.why: Yes/no question turned into four choices; uses BSB wording 'blood of Jesus'

children-batch4:little:147.question: What does going under the water in baptism show?
children-batch4:little:147.answer: Being buried with Jesus and raised to a new life
wrong: Learning how to swim in deep water
Taking a bath to get clean before dinner
Getting a cool drink on a hot day

children-batch4:little:148.question: In whose name did Jesus say to baptize people?
children-batch4:little:148.answer: The Father, Son, and Holy Spirit
wrong: Peter, James, and his brother John
children-batch4:little:148.why: Asks what the verse says; 'Holy Ghost' changed to 'Holy Spirit'

children-batch4:little:149.question: How should all who are baptized live?

children-batch4:little:15.question: What was the name of the first man?

children-batch4:little:150.question: Who should be baptized?
children-batch4:little:150.answer: People who repent and believe in Jesus
wrong: Only people who live in Israel

children-batch4:little:151.dropped: Rests on an argument from what the Bible does not say; no passage says this

children-batch4:little:152.dropped: Asks about what the Bible leaves out; no passage states this

children-batch4:little:153.question: How many baptisms does Paul say there are?
children-batch4:little:153.why: Changed to what Ephesians 4:5 says (one baptism); the verse does not speak of ways to baptize

children-batch4:little:154.dropped: A ruling on other churches that no passage of the Bible states

children-batch4:little:155.question: What did Jesus begin when He was about thirty years old?
children-batch4:little:155.why: Follows BSB 'began His ministry'; simpler words

children-batch4:little:156.dropped: No verse says three years; it is only worked out from the feasts in John

children-batch4:little:157.question: Besides teaching the people, what else did Jesus do?
children-batch4:little:157.why: Names Jesus; yes/no question turned into four choices from Matthew 4:23

children-batch4:little:158.question: What is a miracle?
children-batch4:little:158.answer: A wonderful work done by God's power
children-batch4:little:158.why: Answer tied to John 3:2; added choices

children-batch4:little:159.question: What miracle did Jesus do for Lazarus?
children-batch4:little:159.answer: He raised him from the dead
wrong: He fed him bread and fish
He calmed a storm for him
children-batch4:little:159.why: Made a question about Lazarus with four choices

children-batch4:little:16.question: What was the name of the first woman?

children-batch4:little:160.question: What did Jesus do for the ten lepers who called out to Him?
children-batch4:little:160.answer: He made them clean and well
wrong: He gave them bread and fish
He sent them away in a boat
He made them kings of the village
children-batch4:little:160.why: Says who the question is about (the ten lepers); simpler words

children-batch4:little:161.question: What did Jesus do for the man in Mark 2 who could not walk?
children-batch4:little:161.answer: He made him able to walk
wrong: He gave him a new house
He told him to stay in bed
He gave him a bag of money
children-batch4:little:161.why: Says the man who could not walk instead of 'the lame'; matches Mark 2

children-batch4:little:162.question: What happened to the man who could not talk after Jesus drove out the demon?
children-batch4:little:162.why: Says 'man who could not talk' instead of 'the dumb'; matches Matthew 9

children-batch4:little:163.question: What did Jesus do for the blind man He sent to wash in the Pool of Siloam?
children-batch4:little:163.answer: He made him able to see
wrong: He gave him a new coat
He made him able to talk
children-batch4:little:163.why: Names the blind man in John 9; simpler words

children-batch4:little:164.question: What did the wind and the sea do when Jesus said, "Be still!"?
children-batch4:little:164.answer: They obeyed Him and became calm
wrong: They blew and splashed even harder
They kept on roaring all night
children-batch4:little:164.why: Yes-or-no question turned into a four-choice question

children-batch4:little:165.question: What did the works Jesus did show about Him?
children-batch4:little:165.answer: That God the Father sent Him
wrong: That He wanted to be rich
children-batch4:little:165.why: Simpler words; said as Jesus says it in John 5:36

children-batch4:little:166.question: How many men did Jesus choose to go with Him?
children-batch4:little:166.why: Asks how many so the choices are clear

children-batch4:little:167.question: What did Jesus call the twelve men He chose?

children-batch4:little:168.question: What did Jesus send His twelve apostles out to do?
children-batch4:little:168.why: Names the apostles; answer kept to what the verse says

children-batch4:little:169.question: What power did Jesus give His twelve disciples?
children-batch4:little:169.answer: To drive out evil spirits and heal
wrong: To turn plain stones into shiny gold
To rule over the whole land
To make it rain every day
children-batch4:little:169.why: Names the disciples; answer follows the verse

children-batch4:little:17.question: What did God make Adam from?

children-batch4:little:170.question: What did Jesus say the world did to Him?
children-batch4:little:170.why: Yes-or-no question changed to match the verse given (the world hated Jesus)

children-batch4:little:171.question: What did the chief priests and Pharisees plan to do to Jesus?
children-batch4:little:171.why: Names the leaders instead of 'they'; told simply

children-batch4:little:172.question: How did the crowd sent by the chief priests find Jesus?
children-batch4:little:172.why: Names who was looking for Jesus

children-batch4:little:173.question: How did Judas show the crowd which man was Jesus?
children-batch4:little:173.answer: He greeted Him and kissed Him
wrong: He pointed and shouted His name
He waved a red cloth at Him
He rang a bell beside Him
children-batch4:little:173.why: Names Judas and the crowd; BSB words 'Greetings, Rabbi!'

children-batch4:little:174.question: Who was Judas Iscariot?
wrong: The high priest of the temple

children-batch4:little:175.question: Where was Jesus when Judas and the crowd came to arrest Him?
wrong: In a boat on the Sea of Galilee
children-batch4:little:175.why: Named Judas and the crowd; used the BSB's 'a place called Gethsemane'; added choices.

children-batch4:little:176.question: Why did Jesus go to Gethsemane?
children-batch4:little:176.why: Named Jesus and Gethsemane; added choices.

children-batch4:little:177.question: After Jesus was arrested, who was He taken to?
children-batch4:little:177.why: Simpler words; named Caiaphas as the BSB does; 'arrested' in place of 'betrayed'; added choices.

children-batch4:little:178.question: What did Pilate say about Jesus after questioning Him?
children-batch4:little:178.answer: "I find no basis for a charge against Him."
children-batch4:little:178.why: Yes/no question turned into four choices; BSB quote.
children-batch4:little:178.fixed: The answer is in quote marks but does not match the BSB. The BSB says "I find no basis for a charge against Him" (John 18:38; Luke 23:4 says "this man"). A quote should give the verse's own words.

children-batch4:little:179.question: Pilate wanted to let Jesus go. Why didn't he?
wrong: Jesus asked to stay in prison
Pilate thought Jesus had done evil
Jesus' disciples asked Pilate to keep Him
children-batch4:little:179.why: Named Pilate and Jesus; 'the Jews' changed to the crowd as the verses say; added choices.

children-batch4:little:18.question: How did God make Eve?
wrong: From the dust of the ground
From a tree in the garden

children-batch4:little:180.question: What did the crowd shout to Pilate about Jesus?
children-batch4:little:180.why: Says who spoke and to whom; BSB wording; added choices.

children-batch4:little:181.question: To what place did the soldiers take Jesus to crucify Him?
children-batch4:little:181.answer: Golgotha, the Place of the Skull
wrong: The top of the Mount of Olives
The bank of the Jordan River
children-batch4:little:181.why: Calvary changed to Golgotha as the BSB has it; named Jesus; added choices.

children-batch4:little:182.question: How was Jesus put to death at Golgotha?
children-batch4:little:182.answer: He was crucified on a cross
wrong: He was put in a lions' den
He was thrown into a fiery furnace
He was sent away on a ship
children-batch4:little:182.why: Asked plainly and gently how Jesus died; the verse gives no more detail; added choices.

children-batch4:little:183.question: What held Jesus' hands to the cross?
children-batch4:little:183.why: Made it stand alone; John 20:25 names only nails in His hands, so 'feet' was dropped; added choices.

children-batch4:little:184.question: About how many hours was Jesus on the cross, from the third hour to the ninth hour?
children-batch4:little:184.why: Named Jesus; answer tied to the verses' hours; added choices.

children-batch4:little:185.question: What happened to the sky while Jesus was on the cross?
children-batch4:little:185.answer: Darkness came over all the land
wrong: Snow fell over all the land
A rainbow filled the whole sky
The sun shone brighter than ever

children-batch4:little:186.question: What did Jesus pray for the people who crucified Him?
children-batch4:little:186.why: Yes/no question turned into four choices; BSB quote.

children-batch4:little:187.question: Why did Jesus come into the world and die?
wrong: Because He had done something wrong
children-batch4:little:187.why: Named Jesus; kept the teaching in the verse's words; added choices.

children-batch4:little:188.question: Why does everyone need Jesus to save them?
wrong: Because heaven is too far away
Because only grown-ups can be good
children-batch4:little:188.why: Yes/no question turned into four choices; kept the teaching that all have sinned.

children-batch4:little:189.question: On what day did Jesus rise from the dead?
children-batch4:little:189.answer: The first day of the week
children-batch4:little:189.why: Dropped 'now our Sabbath', which the verses don't say; BSB wording; added choices.

children-batch4:little:19.question: Where did God put Adam and Eve to live?
wrong: In a tent in the desert

children-batch4:little:190.question: Who did Jesus appear to after He rose from the dead?

children-batch4:little:191.question: How did the disciples know that Jesus was really alive and not a spirit?
children-batch4:little:191.answer: He showed His hands and ate fish
wrong: He flew around the room above them
He sang a song in the temple
He showed them a letter from Pilate
children-batch4:little:191.why: Named the disciples; the answer now follows the verses (the verses don't say He drank)

children-batch4:little:192.question: What did Jesus tell His disciples to do after He rose from the dead?
children-batch4:little:192.answer: Go and preach the gospel to everyone
wrong: Stay home and keep very quiet
Build a big temple in Jerusalem
Go back to fishing and forget Him
children-batch4:little:192.why: Named Jesus; took out the King James wording

children-batch4:little:193.question: How long did Jesus stay on the earth after He rose from the dead?

children-batch4:little:194.question: How did Jesus go up to heaven?
children-batch4:little:194.answer: He was taken up into the sky
wrong: He rode up on a white horse
He climbed up a tall ladder
He sailed away on a boat

children-batch4:little:195.question: What did the two men dressed in white say Jesus will do one day?
children-batch4:little:195.answer: Come back the same way He went
wrong: Stay in heaven and never return
Send an angel in His place
Come back as a little baby
children-batch4:little:195.why: Yes-or-no question made into four choices; the answer now follows Acts 1:11

children-batch4:little:196.question: What did Jesus say will happen one day to everyone who is in their grave?
children-batch4:little:196.answer: They will hear His voice and come out
wrong: They will stay in their graves forever
They will all turn into angels
children-batch4:little:196.fixed: John 5:28-29 says nothing about Jesus rising from the dead, so the question adds something the verses do not give. Also, 'raised to life' fits only those who did good. The verses say all will come out, some to life and some to judgment.

children-batch4:little:197.question: Besides the dead being raised, what else will happen to all of us at the last day?
children-batch4:little:197.answer: We will stand before Christ the Judge
wrong: We will forget everything we did
Nobody will ever be judged at all
Only angels will meet with Christ
children-batch4:little:197.why: Question made to stand on its own

children-batch4:little:198.question: Why must we all stand before the judgment seat of Christ?
children-batch4:little:198.answer: To be judged for what we did
wrong: To be given a brand new name
To pick a new king for us
To learn how to read and write
children-batch4:little:198.why: Question made to stand on its own; simpler words

children-batch4:little:199.question: What did Jesus say will happen to the wicked at the end?
children-batch4:little:199.why: Named Jesus as the speaker; simpler words, still teaching judgment

children-batch4:little:2.question: Who is God?
children-batch4:little:2.answer: God is the maker of all things
wrong: An angel who lives in the clouds
The first man on the earth
A king who ruled over Egypt

children-batch4:little:20.question: What was in the garden of Eden?
children-batch4:little:20.answer: Trees good for food, and the tree of life
children-batch4:little:20.why: Took out flowers, which the verse doesn't mention; answer now matches the verse's trees.

children-batch4:little:200.question: What did Jesus say will happen to the righteous at the end?
children-batch4:little:200.answer: They will go into life that never ends
wrong: They will sleep in the grave forever
They will become stars in the sky
children-batch4:little:200.why: Changed 'the good' to 'the righteous' as in the BSB; simpler words

children-batch4:little:21.question: What did God tell Adam not to do?
children-batch4:little:21.answer: Eat from the tree of the knowledge of good and evil
wrong: Give names to any of the animals in the garden
Eat fruit from any of the trees in the garden
Walk around in the garden or take care of it
children-batch4:little:21.why: Named Adam and the tree, as the verse does.

children-batch4:little:22.question: God told Adam and Eve not to eat from the tree of the knowledge of good and evil. Who obeyed Him?
children-batch4:little:22.why: Yes-or-no question made into four choices; named Adam and Eve.
children-batch4:little:22.fixed: The question said only "the tree" and did not say which one. It now names the tree, so the question makes sense on its own. The answer is still right: Genesis 3:6 says both of them ate.

children-batch4:little:23.question: How did Adam and Eve disobey God?
children-batch4:little:23.answer: They ate fruit God told them not to eat
wrong: They ran away from the garden God made
They cut down the tree in the garden
They forgot to name all the animals

children-batch4:little:24.question: When Adam and Eve hid from God among the trees, could God see them?
children-batch4:little:24.why: Yes-or-no question made into four choices; kept the teaching that God sees all things.

children-batch4:little:25.question: How did God punish Adam and Eve after they ate the fruit?
children-batch4:little:25.answer: He sent them out of the Garden of Eden
wrong: He made them build a big boat to live in
He sent them far away to live in Egypt
He made them sleep for a whole year
children-batch4:little:25.why: Named Adam and Eve; made it a question with four choices

children-batch4:little:26.question: What did God say would happen to Adam because he ate the fruit?
children-batch4:little:26.answer: He would one day die and return to dust
wrong: He would live forever and never grow old
He would become a great and rich king
He would turn into an angel in heaven
children-batch4:little:26.why: Named Adam; answer follows the verses (die, return to dust)

children-batch4:little:27.question: After Adam and Eve sinned, what did God promise would one day come from the woman's family?
children-batch4:little:27.answer: A Saviour who would crush the serpent's head
children-batch4:little:27.why: Made it stand on its own; tied the Saviour to the verse's promise

children-batch4:little:28.question: Who was Cain?
children-batch4:little:28.answer: The first son of Adam and Eve
wrong: A king who ruled over Egypt
One of the three sons of Noah
An angel who lived in the garden

children-batch4:little:29.question: Who was Abel?
wrong: A king who built a city
children-batch4:little:29.why: Added that Abel kept sheep, from the verse; added wrong choices

children-batch4:little:3.question: Out of what did God make all things?
children-batch4:little:3.answer: Out of nothing that could be seen
wrong: Out of sand and water from the sea
Out of old broken stars in space
Out of clay from a big river
children-batch4:little:3.why: Named God; plain words; kept the teaching that He made all things from nothing

children-batch4:little:30.question: What does the Bible say Abel did?
children-batch4:little:30.answer: He trusted God and gave Him his best
wrong: He refused to give God anything
He ran away and hid from God
children-batch4:little:30.why: Yes/no question changed; answer now follows the verses (by faith, best offering)

children-batch4:little:31.question: What does the Bible say about the things Cain did?
wrong: His deeds were kind and good
He gave God his very best
children-batch4:little:31.why: Yes/no question changed; uses what 1 John 3:12 says

children-batch4:little:32.question: How did Cain feel when God was pleased with Abel's offering but not with his?
children-batch4:little:32.why: Yes/no question changed; uses 'very angry', which is what the verses say

children-batch4:little:33.question: What did Cain say when the LORD asked him, "Where is your brother Abel?"
children-batch4:little:33.why: The killing is no longer the point; the question asks about Cain lying to God

children-batch4:little:34.question: How did God punish Cain for what he did to Abel?
children-batch4:little:34.answer: He made him a wanderer on the earth
wrong: He made him a great and rich king
He gave him a big, rich farm
He sent him off to build an ark
children-batch4:little:34.why: Yes/no question changed; asks how God punished Cain

children-batch4:little:35.dropped: Asks about the child's own life, and no Bible passage is given for it

children-batch4:little:36.question: What does the Bible say the eyes of the LORD see?
children-batch4:little:36.answer: Everything, the evil and the good
children-batch4:little:36.why: Changed from a question about the child to what the verse says

children-batch4:little:37.question: What did Jesus say will happen to people unless they repent (turn away from their sins)?
children-batch4:little:37.why: Changed from a question about the child to Jesus' words; kept the warning, said gently

children-batch4:little:38.question: What did God do because He loved the world so much?
children-batch4:little:38.answer: He gave His one and only Son
wrong: He made a brand new garden
He sent a great flood of water
He built a tall tower to heaven
children-batch4:little:38.why: Changed from a question about the child to God's love shown in the verse

children-batch4:little:39.question: Who was Noah?
children-batch4:little:39.answer: A good man who walked with God
wrong: The very first man God made
Cain's younger brother who kept sheep
A king who ruled over Egypt
children-batch4:little:39.why: Removed the date, which the verse does not give; used the verse's words

children-batch4:little:4.question: How did God make all things?
children-batch4:little:4.answer: He spoke, and it came to be
wrong: He built them with tools over many years
He asked the angels to make them

children-batch4:little:40.question: What were the people on earth like in Noah's time?
wrong: They were all kind and good
children-batch4:little:40.why: Made it a 'what' question about Noah's time; dropped the 'except Noah' part, which Genesis 6:5 does not say

children-batch4:little:41.question: What did God send on the earth because the people were so wicked?
children-batch4:little:41.why: Turned the yes/no question into a question about what God sent

children-batch4:little:42.question: How were Noah and his family kept safe from the flood?
children-batch4:little:42.why: Named the flood; made the answer a short choice

children-batch4:little:43.question: What was the ark that Noah built?
children-batch4:little:43.why: Named Noah so the question makes sense on its own

children-batch4:little:44.question: How were the animals and birds kept safe from the flood?
children-batch4:little:44.answer: Pairs of each kind went into the ark
wrong: They flew up to the mountains
They swam until the water went down

children-batch4:little:45.question: What were the names of Noah's three sons?

children-batch4:little:46.question: What did God promise Noah about floods?
children-batch4:little:46.answer: Never again a flood to destroy the earth
wrong: A flood would come every hundred years
Another flood would come very soon
Only the animals would be safe next time
children-batch4:little:46.why: Turned the yes/no question into a question about God's promise

children-batch4:little:47.question: The Bible says the earth will be destroyed again on the day of judgment. How will that happen?
children-batch4:little:47.why: Turned the yes/no question into a 'how' question; kept the teaching on judgment

children-batch4:little:48.question: Abraham was first called Abram. What did Abram do that God counted as righteous?
children-batch4:little:48.why: Asked what the verse says about Abraham (he believed God); explained his first name Abram

children-batch4:little:49.question: What did God tell Abraham (then called Abram) to do?
children-batch4:little:49.answer: Leave home and go to a new land
wrong: Build a big boat for the animals
Stay home and live with his father
Go to the city and be king
children-batch4:little:49.why: Explained the name Abram; filled out the answer from the verse

children-batch4:little:5.question: What did God make on the first day?

children-batch4:little:50.question: When God told Abram to leave his home, what did Abram do?
children-batch4:little:50.answer: He obeyed and went to Canaan
wrong: He stayed at home in Haran
He hid from God in a cave
He sailed far across the sea
children-batch4:little:50.why: Turned the yes/no question into a question about what Abram did

children-batch4:little:51.question: Who was Isaac?
wrong: Abraham's brother who lived far away
children-batch4:little:51.why: Dropped Sarah, who is not in the verse; simpler words

children-batch4:little:52.question: What hard thing did God tell Abraham to do with his son Isaac?
children-batch4:little:52.answer: Offer Isaac to God on a mountain
wrong: Send Isaac far away to Egypt
Teach Isaac to be a shepherd
children-batch4:little:52.why: Told gently; kept to the verse

children-batch4:little:53.question: Why did God ask Abraham to offer up his son Isaac?
wrong: God wanted Abraham to move away
children-batch4:little:53.why: 'Try' changed to 'test', as in the BSB

children-batch4:little:54.question: Abraham obeyed God and laid Isaac on the altar. What happened next?
children-batch4:little:54.answer: The angel of the LORD stopped him
wrong: Isaac jumped up and ran away
A storm blew the altar down
Sarah came running and stopped him
children-batch4:little:54.why: Turned the yes/no question into a 'what happened' question; told gently

children-batch4:little:55.question: Whom did Abraham love even more than his son Isaac?
children-batch4:little:55.why: Asked it through the verse: Abraham did not keep back his son from God.

children-batch4:little:56.question: Jesus said what the greatest commandment is. How must we love God?
children-batch4:little:56.answer: With all our heart, soul, and mind
children-batch4:little:56.why: Yes-or-no question made into four choices, using Jesus' words
children-batch4:little:56.fixed: It brings in Abraham, but Matthew 22:37-38 doesn't mention him. Jesus is answering a question about the greatest commandment.

children-batch4:little:57.question: Why must we love God more than anything else?
children-batch4:little:57.answer: Because God is the best of all
wrong: Because our friends tell us to
children-batch4:little:57.why: Simpler words; reference moved to the verse that says God alone is good

children-batch4:little:58.question: Moses told God's people to walk in all of God's ways. How much must we obey God?
wrong: Only when we feel like it
children-batch4:little:58.why: Yes-or-no question made into four choices; added a reference
children-batch4:little:58.fixed: It brings in Abraham, but these verses don't mention him. Here Moses tells the Israelites to obey God in all His ways.

children-batch4:little:59.question: Why must we obey God?
children-batch4:little:59.answer: Because God has commanded us to
wrong: So people will think we are great
children-batch4:little:59.why: Kept the catechism's teaching; reference moved to a verse about God's command

children-batch4:little:60.why: Says what is given and where; reference moved to the verse that names Moses

children-batch4:little:61.question: God first gave the Ten Commandments to which people, the ones He brought out of Egypt?
children-batch4:little:61.why: Made it stand on its own

children-batch4:little:62.why: Made it stand on its own; reference moved to a verse that says this is everyone's duty

children-batch4:little:63.why: Named the Ten Commandments; wrong choices added

children-batch4:little:64.question: How many commandments did God write on the stone tablets?
children-batch4:little:64.why: Named God's Commandments; reference moved to a verse that says 'Ten'

children-batch4:little:65.question: What does the Bible say is the whole duty of every person?
children-batch4:little:65.answer: Fear God and keep His commandments
wrong: Get rich and become very famous
Do whatever we like each day
Eat, drink, and play all day
children-batch4:little:65.why: Yes-or-no question made into four choices from the verse

children-batch4:little:66.question: What is the first of the Ten Commandments?
children-batch4:little:66.answer: Have no other gods before Me
wrong: Remember the Sabbath and keep it holy
Honor your father and your mother
Do not steal from your neighbor

children-batch4:little:67.question: What is the second of the Ten Commandments?
children-batch4:little:67.answer: Do not make or worship idols
wrong: Do not lie about your neighbor
children-batch4:little:67.why: Answer put in BSB words, said simply

children-batch4:little:68.question: What is the third of the Ten Commandments?
children-batch4:little:68.answer: Do not take the LORD's name in vain

children-batch4:little:69.question: What is the fourth of the Ten Commandments?
children-batch4:little:69.answer: Remember the Sabbath day by keeping it holy
wrong: Have no other gods before Me

children-batch4:little:7.question: What did God call the darkness?

children-batch4:little:72.question: What is the seventh Commandment?
children-batch4:little:72.why: BSB wording; the commandment's words kept, nothing grown-up added

children-batch4:little:74.answer: You shall not bear false witness.

children-batch4:little:75.question: What is the tenth Commandment?
children-batch4:little:75.answer: You shall not covet anything that belongs to your neighbor.
wrong: You shall not bear false witness against your neighbor.

children-batch4:little:76.question: Jesus said all of God's law hangs on two commandments. What are they about?
children-batch4:little:76.answer: Loving God and loving your neighbor

children-batch4:little:76.why: yes-or-no question made into four choices, using Jesus' two great commandments

children-batch4:little:77.question: What does the first great commandment teach us to do?
children-batch4:little:77.answer: Love God with all your heart
wrong: Love only your friends and family
children-batch4:little:77.why: named the first part; matched BSB (heart, soul, mind)

children-batch4:little:78.question: What does the second great commandment teach us to do?
wrong: Love your neighbor only if he is kind
children-batch4:little:78.why: named the second part; simpler wording

children-batch4:little:79.question: What does the Bible say about all people?
children-batch4:little:79.why: simpler words for 'character of all men'

wrong: They will be punished for one day.
children-batch4:little:81.why: named sinners who are not saved; teaching kept, said gently

children-batch4:little:82.question: What did God give so that sinners who believe would not perish?
children-batch4:little:82.why: yes-or-no question made into four choices from John 3:16

children-batch4:little:83.answer: By turning away from their sins to God
wrong: By just trying to forget their sins
children-batch4:little:83.why: named who and what; matched to Acts 3:19 (repent and turn back)

children-batch4:little:84.answer: At His baptism, God said, "This is My beloved Son."
wrong: When Jesus was born, a king said, "This is my son."
When Jesus was a boy, Joseph wrote it on a wall.
When Jesus was baptized, a dove said it out loud.
children-batch4:little:84.why: named Jesus; simpler wording, BSB quote

children-batch4:little:85.question: Where was Jesus born?
children-batch4:little:85.why: Shortened the answer and used the BSB wording.

wrong: A lamb and a young goat
children-batch4:little:86.why: The verses don't say Jesus' parents were poor, so the question now asks about the offering they gave. The poorer-family offering is in Leviticus 12:8.

children-batch4:little:87.question: Where was Jesus before He came into our world?
children-batch4:little:87.answer: With God His Father, in glory
wrong: In Nazareth with Joseph and Mary
children-batch4:little:87.why: Answer now matches John 17:5 and the question says Jesus.

children-batch4:little:88.question: When Jesus was born, who were watching their flocks in the fields at night?

children-batch4:little:89.why: Turned the definition into a question about what shepherds care for.
children-batch4:little:89.fixed: The question was a general one and did not say it was about the shepherds in this story. It now asks about those shepherds and uses the verse's word 'flocks'.

children-batch4:little:9.question: What did God make to shine in the sky at night?
children-batch4:little:9.answer: A smaller light and the stars
children-batch4:little:9.why: Named God; used the BSB's wording, since the verse says 'lesser light', not 'moon'

children-batch4:little:90.question: Who appeared to the shepherds?
wrong: A wise man from the east

children-batch4:little:91.question: What shone around the shepherds when the angel came?
wrong: The light of the full moon
children-batch4:little:91.why: Says who it was about and drops the old wording.

children-batch4:little:92.question: How did the shepherds feel when they saw the angel?

children-batch4:little:93.answer: He brought good news of joy
wrong: He was going to leave soon
The sheep were all fast asleep
The long night was almost over
children-batch4:little:93.why: Changed the yes-or-no question into a 'why' question.

children-batch4:little:94.question: How should the shepherds feel about the angel's news?
children-batch4:little:94.why: Made it stand on its own and tied the answer to 'great joy'.

children-batch4:little:95.answer: "Do not be afraid! I bring good news."
wrong: "Run away and hide from me now!"

"Leave your sheep and go back home!"

children-batch4:little:96.question: What was the good news the angel told the shepherds?
children-batch4:little:96.answer: A Savior was born in the city of David
wrong: A new king was crowned in the city of Rome
A big feast was ready in the city of Jerusalem
Rain was coming soon for all of their fields
children-batch4:little:96.why: Used the BSB wording and made it stand on its own.

children-batch4:little:97.question: Which town did the angel mean by "the city of David"?
children-batch4:little:97.why: Made it stand on its own.

children-batch4:little:98.question: Why was Bethlehem called the city of David?
wrong: David built it all by himself
An angel named it for David
David sailed there on a boat
children-batch4:little:98.why: The verses don't say David was born in Bethlehem, so the answer now says his family lived there (Jesse of Bethlehem).

children-batch4:little:99.question: What happened after the angel told the shepherds the good news?
wrong: The shepherds all fell fast asleep
The angel flew to King Herod
children-batch4:little:99.why: Made it stand on its own and used the BSB facts.

children-batch4:manly:1.dropped: Asks what a Greek word means; no Bible passage defines the word 'gospel'

children-batch4:manly:100.answer: They were warned in a dream

children-batch4:manly:101.question: Where did the wise men go after they saw Jesus?

children-batch4:manly:102.why: Named the wise men; made it a who question

children-batch4:manly:103.answer: Take Jesus and Mary to Egypt

children-batch4:manly:104.question: Why did the angel tell Joseph to take Jesus and Mary to Egypt?
children-batch4:manly:104.why: Named Joseph and the angel; BSB wording, said gently

children-batch4:manly:105.question: How long did Joseph stay in Egypt with Jesus and Mary?

children-batch4:manly:106.question: In what town did Joseph go to live with Jesus and Mary after Egypt?
children-batch4:manly:106.why: Named Joseph; dropped Mary's earlier home, which these verses do not give

children-batch4:manly:108.why: Named Herod; told gently, without making the killing the point

children-batch4:manly:109.question: Where did the parents of Jesus go every year?

children-batch4:manly:11.question: How did Matthew, the tax collector, become a follower of Jesus?
children-batch4:manly:11.answer: Jesus said, "Follow Me," and he did

He saw Jesus walk on the water

children-batch4:manly:110.question: Why did the parents of Jesus go to Jerusalem every year?
children-batch4:manly:110.answer: For the Feast of the Passover

children-batch4:manly:111.question: How old was Jesus when He stayed behind in Jerusalem after the Feast?

children-batch4:manly:112.question: What happened as Mary and Joseph started home from Jerusalem?
children-batch4:manly:112.answer: The boy Jesus stayed behind in Jerusalem
wrong: A storm stopped them on the road
An angel told them to go to Egypt

children-batch4:manly:113.question: Where did Mary and Joseph think Jesus was as they traveled home?

children-batch4:manly:114.why: Named the people; BSB 'for a day'

children-batch4:manly:115.question: When Mary and Joseph could not find Jesus among their relatives and friends, what did they do?
children-batch4:manly:115.answer: They went back to look for Him
wrong: They went on home without Him

They sat and waited by the road

children-batch4:manly:116.question: After how many days did Mary and Joseph find Jesus?

children-batch4:manly:12.question: What did Jesus later choose Matthew to be?
wrong: A king over all of Israel
A high priest in the temple

children-batch4:manly:120.question: What was the boy Jesus doing with the teachers in the temple?
children-batch4:manly:120.why: Named Jesus and the place; answer worded as in the BSB

children-batch4:manly:121.question: How did the people who heard the boy Jesus feel about His answers?

children-batch4:manly:123.question: When His parents found Him, where did the boy Jesus say He had to be?

The old answer turned His words into a statement and put them in quote marks as if He said them that way. The fixed question asks where Jesus said He had to be.

children-batch4:manly:124.question: After His parents found Him, where did the boy Jesus go?
wrong: Back into the temple to live

children-batch4:manly:125.question: How did the boy Jesus act toward His parents in Nazareth?
wrong: He would not listen to them
children-batch4:manly:125.why: Changed 'subject unto them' to the BSB's 'obedient'; named Jesus

children-batch4:manly:126.answer: Wiser and taller, pleasing God and people
children-batch4:manly:126.why: Named Jesus; put 'stature' and 'favor' in simple words

children-batch4:manly:127.question: Who was sent to prepare the way for the Lord?

wrong: Rome, Egypt, and around the Nile

Greece, Spain, and the far islands

children-batch4:mtc:1431.fixed: The verse says everyone who believes Jesus is the Christ has been born of God. The question turned this around ('everyone born of God believes'), which the verse does not say. I reworded it to follow the verse and explained 'the Christ' for children.

children-batch4:mtc:1432.why: Made it about Jesus' words; short answer and choices

The feast would be called off this year

children-batch4:mtc:1434.answer: To show them what they should do
wrong: To punish them for something they did
Because washing feet was a Passover rule
To make them laugh at the meal

children-batch4:mtc:1436.answer: Go and talk to him alone

Tell the whole town about it

children-batch4:mtc:1443.question: Jesus said some things come out of the heart and make a person unclean. Which of these did He name?

children-batch4:mtc:1472.fixed: The verses never say 'anywhere'. children-batch4:mtc:1484.question: When Jesus told the demons to come out of the man, where did they beg to go?

children-batch4:mtc:1500.question: What job did Peter, Andrew, James, and John have before they followed Jesus?

children-batch4:mtc:1501.question: What was Matthew's job when Jesus called him?

The captain of the king's guard

children-batch4:mtc:1860.answer: He used to hurt Jesus' followers

children-batch4:mtc:1861.question: Who brought Saul to the apostles and told them how Saul had met Jesus?
children-batch4:mtc:1861.why: Changed the yes-or-no question to ask who helped the disciples trust Saul.

children-batch4:mtc:1863.question: What did the angel at the tomb say about Jesus?

children-batch4:mtc:1864.question: Who did Jesus say was going to come down and give the disciples power?

children-batch4:mtc:1865.question: Where was Jesus going when a cloud hid Him from the disciples?
children-batch4:mtc:1865.why: Changed 'where do you think' into a question the verses answer.

children-batch4:mtc:1868.why: Changed to shepherds (more than one); answer kept to what the verses say

children-batch4:mtc:1869.question: What did Matthew do when Jesus said, "Follow Me"?
children-batch4:mtc:1869.answer: He got up and followed Jesus
wrong: He said he was too busy
He hid in his tax booth
He told Jesus to come back later
children-batch4:mtc:1869.why: Changed a 'why do you think' prompt into a question the verse answers

children-batch4:mtc:187.question: What was Esther's other name?
children-batch4:mtc:187.why: Focused on one fact from the verse, Esther's other name

children-batch4:mtc:1871.question: When Jesus ate with tax collectors and sinners, who did He say He came to call?
wrong: Only people who are already good
children-batch4:mtc:1871.why: The verses don't say Matthew stole; asked instead what Jesus said about why He came

children-batch4:mtc:1872.question: Who brought Jesus back to life after He died?
children-batch4:mtc:1872.why: Changed 'How' to 'Who', which is what the verse answers

children-batch4:mtc:1873.why: Said who 'she' is so the question makes sense alone

children-batch4:mtc:1874.question: What did the Canaanite woman want Jesus to help her with?
children-batch4:mtc:1874.answer: To free her daughter from a demon

To give her some bread to eat
To find her sheep that was lost
children-batch4:mtc:1874.why: Named the woman; said the answer gently

children-batch4:mtc:1875.question: When the disciples asked Jesus to send the Canaanite woman away, what did Jesus say?
children-batch4:mtc:1875.answer: He was sent only to the lost sheep of Israel
wrong: She should go home and rest
He was too tired to help
children-batch4:mtc:1875.why: Printed answer said more than the verses; now asks what Jesus said

children-batch4:mtc:1876.question: When the Canaanite woman asked for help, what did Jesus say was not right to do?
children-batch4:mtc:1876.answer: Toss the children's bread to the dogs
wrong: Give the fish to the hungry birds
Feed the sheep on the Sabbath day
Throw the bread into the deep sea
children-batch4:mtc:1876.why: Printed answer (enemy, didn't deserve help) isn't in the verse; now asks what Jesus said

children-batch4:mtc:1877.question: What did the Canaanite woman say even the dogs get to eat?
children-batch4:mtc:1877.why: Changed to what she said, using her own words from the verse

children-batch4:mtc:1878.question: Why did Jesus help the Canaanite woman in the end?

children-batch4:mtc:1879.question: In Revelation, who did God send to show His servant John what must soon happen?
children-batch4:mtc:1879.why: The verses don't say which John he is; asked instead who God sent to John

children-batch4:mtc:188.question: Who was the man in charge of the young women at the king's palace in Susa?
children-batch4:mtc:188.why: Named the place so the question stands alone; removed the pronunciation note

children-batch4:mtc:1880.question: In Revelation, John says "the time is near." What time is near?
children-batch4:mtc:1880.answer: The time for Jesus to come back
wrong: The time for John to go home
The time to build the temple
children-batch4:mtc:1880.why: Gave a reference in Revelation 1 about Jesus coming back; added choices

children-batch4:mtc:1881.question: Who does John say the book of Revelation is about?
children-batch4:mtc:1881.why: Verse 1 says the revelation is of Jesus Christ, not just God; made the question clear

children-batch4:mtc:1882.question: In Revelation, God says He is the One "who is and was and is to come." What does that tell us about God?
children-batch4:mtc:1882.answer: He has always lived and always will
wrong: He was born in Bethlehem long ago
He will stop living one day
He lived only a long time ago
children-batch4:mtc:1882.why: Named God; turned the 'why' into a plain question with choices

children-batch4:mtc:1883.question: Revelation calls Jesus "the faithful witness." What does Jesus do as the faithful witness?
children-batch4:mtc:1883.answer: He tells the truth about God
wrong: He writes down all the laws
children-batch4:mtc:1883.why: Named Jesus; shortened answer; added verse about Jesus telling the truth

children-batch4:mtc:1884.question: Why is Jesus called "the firstborn from the dead"?
children-batch4:mtc:1884.answer: He rose from the dead first, and His people will rise later
wrong: He was the first baby ever born
children-batch4:mtc:1884.why: Named Jesus; shortened answer; added verse about Jesus rising first
children-batch4:mtc:1884.fixed: 'The first to rise forever' is unclear wording for a child, and the verses given do not say it in those words. 1 Corinthians 15:20-23 teaches that Christ rose first, as the firstfruits, and that those who belong to Him will rise later.

children-batch4:mtc:1885.question: Why is Jesus the ruler of the kings of the earth?
children-batch4:mtc:1885.answer: He is God, the King over all kings
wrong: He was born to a rich family
He was the tallest man on earth
children-batch4:mtc:1885.why: Simpler words; added verse naming Jesus King of kings
children-batch4:mtc:1885.fixed: The wrong choice 'He won a big army battle' is too close to Revelation 17:14, where the Lamb makes war and wins over the kings. A child could think it is right too. I replaced it with a choice that is plainly wrong.

children-batch4:mtc:1886.question: Revelation says Jesus "released us from our sins by His blood." How did Jesus do that?
children-batch4:mtc:1886.answer: He died in our place for our sins
wrong: He paid for us with bags of gold
He told us that sins do not matter
He made us work very hard all day
children-batch4:mtc:1886.why: Fixed wording to match BSB; shortened answer

children-batch4:mtc:1887.question: Revelation says Jesus has made His people to be a kingdom. What does it mean to be God's kingdom?
children-batch4:mtc:1887.answer: We obey God as our King
wrong: We each get our own castle
We never have to obey anyone
We live in one big country
children-batch4:mtc:1887.why: Named Jesus and the verse's words; shortened answer
children-batch4:mtc:1887.fixed: The wrong choice 'We rule over other people' is too close to the teaching that God's people will reign, so it could seem right. I replaced it with a choice that is plainly wrong.

children-batch4:mtc:1888.question: Revelation says Jesus has made His people priests to God. What does that mean for us?
wrong: We all live in the temple
We all stop going to work
children-batch4:mtc:1888.why: Named Jesus and the verse's words; shortened answer

children-batch4:mtc:1889.question: When Jesus comes back with the clouds, who will see Him?
children-batch4:mtc:1889.answer: Every eye, even those who pierced Him
wrong: No one, because the clouds hide Him
children-batch4:mtc:1889.fixed: The verse says only that all the tribes of the earth will mourn 'because of Him'. It never says the mourners are people who didn't believe or that they are 'sorry', so the answer adds a reason the verse does not give. The fixed question asks what the verse plainly says: every eye will see Him, even those who pierced Him.

children-batch4:mtc:189.question: How did Hegai treat Esther?
children-batch4:mtc:189.answer: He liked her and gave her the best place
wrong: He was angry and sent her back home
He would not let her eat any food
He forgot all about her for months
children-batch4:mtc:189.why: Shortened the answer into a child's words

children-batch4:mtc:1890.question: God says, "I am the Alpha and the Omega." What does that mean?
children-batch4:mtc:1890.answer: He is the First and the Last
wrong: He is the biggest and the smallest
He is the oldest of the kings
He is the strongest of the angels
children-batch4:mtc:1890.why: Shortened answer; added verse that explains Alpha and Omega

children-batch4:mtc:1891.question: Why was John on the island of Patmos?
children-batch4:mtc:1891.answer: Because of God's word and his telling about Jesus
wrong: To catch fish in the sea
children-batch4:mtc:1891.why: Dropped the prison camp detail from church history, which the Bible does not give; asked what the verse says

children-batch4:mtc:1892.question: Who did John see standing among the seven golden lampstands?
children-batch4:mtc:1892.why: Named John and what he saw; added verses showing it was Jesus

children-batch4:mtc:1893.question: When John saw Jesus in heaven, what was Jesus' face like?
children-batch4:mtc:1893.answer: Like the sun shining at its brightest
wrong: Like a tired and very sad man
Like a dark and cloudy night sky
Like a small and gentle candle flame
children-batch4:mtc:1893.why: Yes-or-no question turned into a four-choice question about Jesus' glory

children-batch4:mtc:1894.question: John saw One "like the Son of Man." What does that name tell us about Jesus?
children-batch4:mtc:1894.why: Named John and Jesus; BSB wording 'Son of Man'; shortened answer
children-batch4:mtc:1894.fixed: 'Son of Man' does not mean 'God's Son,' so the answer mixed up the two titles. Also, the wrong choice 'He is just an ordinary man' was too close to the true answer that He became a man.

children-batch4:mtc:1895.question: Jesus held seven stars in His right hand, and the stars were the angels of the seven churches. What does that show about Jesus and His churches?
children-batch4:mtc:1895.answer: Jesus rules them and cares for them
wrong: Jesus is very far away from them
The churches are lost and all alone
The churches take care of Jesus instead
children-batch4:mtc:1895.why: Matched the verse: the stars are the angels of the churches; shortened answer

children-batch4:mtc:1896.question: When Jesus was on the cross, what did He pray for the people who hurt Him?
children-batch4:mtc:1896.why: Told more gently; answer uses the BSB's words

children-batch4:mtc:1897.question: In Jesus' story of the net, what did the fishermen do with the good fish?
wrong: Threw them back into the sea
children-batch4:mtc:1897.why: Named the story and the fishermen; 'containers' as in the BSB

children-batch4:mtc:1898.question: In Jesus' story of the net, what did the fishermen do with the bad fish?
children-batch4:mtc:1898.why: Named the story and the fishermen

children-batch4:mtc:1899.question: In Jesus' story of the net, what will the angels do at the end of the age?
children-batch4:mtc:1899.answer: Separate the wicked from the righteous
wrong: Catch fish in a big net
Build a city by the sea
children-batch4:mtc:1899.why: Changed to what the verses say: at the end of the age, angels separate the righteous from the wicked

children-batch4:mtc:19.question: When Peter went up to Jerusalem, who found fault with him for eating with people who were not Jews?

children-batch4:mtc:190.question: What did Mordecai tell Esther not to tell anyone?
children-batch4:mtc:190.answer: Who her people and family were
children-batch4:mtc:190.why: Matched the BSB wording (her people and family)

children-batch4:mtc:1900.question: In Jesus' story of the net, where will the angels throw the wicked at the end of the age?
children-batch4:mtc:1900.why: Changed to follow the verses' words about the wicked, kept the teaching on judgment

children-batch4:mtc:1901.question: Jesus said all authority in heaven and on earth had been given to Him. Who gave it to Him?
children-batch4:mtc:1901.why: 'Power' changed to 'authority' as in the BSB; answer comes from John 3:35

children-batch4:mtc:1902.question: What did Jesus tell His disciples to go and do?
children-batch4:mtc:1902.why: Made the answer short, added choices

children-batch4:mtc:1903.question: How long did Jesus say He would be with His followers?
children-batch4:mtc:1903.answer: Always, even to the end of the age
children-batch4:mtc:1903.why: Said who 'us' is; answer uses the BSB words

children-batch4:mtc:1904.question: Jesus said the Father would send someone to be with His followers forever. Who is it?
children-batch4:mtc:1904.why: Changed to ask what John 14 says plainly: the Father would send the Spirit

children-batch4:mtc:1905.question: In Jesus' story of the sheep and the goats, what good things did the people on the King's right do?
children-batch4:mtc:1905.answer: Fed the hungry and visited the sick
wrong: Built big barns for their grain
Climbed a tall mountain to pray
children-batch4:mtc:1905.why: Named the story and who did the good things; made the answer short

children-batch4:mtc:1906.answer: Feed the hungry or visit the sick
wrong: Build a big boat for the King

Plant a garden for the King
children-batch4:mtc:1906.why: Named the story and the people on the left; made the answer short

children-batch4:mtc:1907.question: In Jesus' story of the sheep and the goats, where did the people on the King's left go?
children-batch4:mtc:1907.why: Said who 'these people' are; answer uses the BSB words, kept the teaching on judgment

children-batch4:mtc:1909.question: God told Solomon in a dream, "Ask, and I will give it to you!" What did Solomon ask for?
children-batch4:mtc:1909.why: Made it match the BSB: a dream, and 'an understanding heart'

children-batch4:mtc:191.question: What did Mordecai do every day while Esther was at the palace?
children-batch4:mtc:191.answer: Walked by to learn how Esther was
wrong: Ate a big dinner with the king
Went fishing down at the river
Rode out to fight in a war

children-batch4:mtc:1910.question: Why did Solomon ask God for an understanding heart?
children-batch4:mtc:1910.why: Changed a word-meaning question into one the verse answers

children-batch4:mtc:1911.question: When King Solomon grew old, what did his wives turn his heart toward?
children-batch4:mtc:1911.why: Made it match the BSB: his wives turned his heart to other gods

children-batch4:mtc:1912.answer: God says to worship only Him

children-batch4:mtc:1913.question: When Judas went to the chief priests to hand Jesus over, what did he ask them?

children-batch4:mtc:1914.question: When did Jesus know that Judas would hand Him over to His enemies?

children-batch4:mtc:1914.fixed: The question asks 'how' Jesus knew, but the answer and John 6:64 tell 'when' he knew (from the beginning). The question now asks 'when'.

children-batch4:mtc:1915.question: At the Last Supper, what did Jesus say the bread was?
children-batch4:mtc:1915.why: Named the Last Supper so the question stands alone. Added choices.

children-batch4:mtc:1916.question: At the Last Supper, what did Jesus say the cup was?
children-batch4:mtc:1916.why: Used 'the cup', as the verse does, and named the Last Supper. Added choices.

children-batch4:mtc:1917.question: What did Hannah name the baby boy God gave her?
children-batch4:mtc:1917.why: Took out the long retelling. Made the question stand alone.

children-batch4:mtc:1918.question: Why was God angry with Eli's sons, Hophni and Phinehas?
children-batch4:mtc:1918.answer: They were wicked and disrespected the LORD's offerings

children-batch4:mtc:1919.question: Why did God say He would judge Eli and his family?
children-batch4:mtc:1919.answer: Eli did not stop his sons' sin

children-batch4:mtc:192.why: Used the BSB words of Psalm 84:11 so the question stands alone

children-batch4:mtc:1921.question: In the Lord's Prayer, where is God's will already being done?
children-batch4:mtc:1921.why: Tied to the Lord's Prayer so it stands alone.

children-batch4:mtc:1922.dropped: Asks about the store; no Bible passage says this.

children-batch4:mtc:1923.dropped: Asks about a bakery; no Bible passage says this.

children-batch4:mtc:1924.dropped: Asks about a farmer selling wheat; no Bible passage says this.

children-batch4:mtc:1925.question: In the Lord's Prayer we ask God for our daily bread. Who makes the crops grow so we can have bread?

children-batch4:mtc:1926.question: What does Jesus say we must do if we want God to forgive us?

children-batch4:mtc:1927.why: Named the Lord's Prayer so the question stands alone; used Matthew 13 for the answer, since 6:13 doesn't say who the evil one is

children-batch4:mtc:1929.question: What did Hannah do with Samuel when he was no longer a baby?
children-batch4:mtc:1929.answer: She took him to serve the LORD
wrong: She sent him away to Egypt

children-batch4:mtc:193.question: Psalm 84 says the LORD holds back no good thing from which people?
children-batch4:mtc:193.answer: Those who live honest, true lives
children-batch4:mtc:193.why: Matched the BSB wording ('walk with integrity') and explained it simply

children-batch4:mtc:1930.question: Who did the boy Samuel serve the LORD with at the house of the LORD?
children-batch4:mtc:1930.why: Named Samuel and said where, matching the verse's wording

children-batch4:mtc:1931.question: When did the LORD first call to the boy Samuel?
children-batch4:mtc:1931.answer: At night, while he lay down
wrong: At noon, out in a field
At sunrise, up on a mountain
children-batch4:mtc:1931.why: Matched the verses: God called Samuel while he was lying down at night, before the lamp went out

children-batch4:mtc:1932.question: Why were Eli's sons bad priests?
children-batch4:mtc:1932.answer: They did not respect the LORD
wrong: They could not read at all
children-batch4:mtc:1932.why: Changed the answer to match the verses (wicked, no respect for the LORD); named Eli's sons

children-batch4:mtc:1934.question: What did God say would happen to Eli's family because of Eli's wicked sons?
children-batch4:mtc:1934.why: Told gently: God would punish Eli's family because Eli honored his sons more than God; added 3:13 for the reason

children-batch4:mtc:1935.question: Why did Eli's sons, Hophni and Phinehas, die, just as God had said?
children-batch4:mtc:1935.answer: God punished them for their wicked sins

They built a very tall tower

children-batch4:mtc:1937.question: What did the Philistine priests say would happen if the Philistines sent God's ark back with a gift?
children-batch4:mtc:1937.why: These verses only promise healing, they don't tell of it, so I asked what the priests said would happen

children-batch4:mtc:1938.question: Who would not bow down to Haman?
wrong: The king's servants at the gate
children-batch4:mtc:1938.why: Used the BSB words 'bow down' and named Haman

children-batch4:mtc:1939.question: How often did the king's servants warn Mordecai to bow down to Haman?
children-batch4:mtc:1939.why: Used simpler words and matched the verse ('warned')

children-batch4:mtc:194.question: How long did the young women get ready before going to King Xerxes?
children-batch4:mtc:194.why: Named who and what it is about

children-batch4:mtc:1940.question: How did Haman feel when Mordecai would not bow down to him?
children-batch4:mtc:1940.why: Changed an open discussion prompt into one question with one answer from the verse

children-batch4:mtc:1941.question: Jesus said someone was a murderer from the beginning and the father of lies. Who was Jesus talking about?

children-batch4:mtc:1944.why: Named the city of Susa; used the BSB word 'confusion'.

children-batch4:mtc:1945.question: What did Mordecai put on when he learned what had happened to the Jews?
children-batch4:mtc:1945.why: Made it stand on its own; asked about his clothes so it differs from q9.

children-batch4:mtc:1946.question: When Mordecai asked Esther to go to the king, what law did she tell him about?

The queen had to stay home always

children-batch4:mtc:1947.question: Who commanded that the servants at the king's gate bow down to Haman?

children-batch4:mtc:1948.question: Who would not bow down to Haman?
children-batch4:mtc:1948.why: Made it stand on its own; used 'bow down' from the BSB.

children-batch4:mtc:1949.question: What law did Haman get King Xerxes to make about the Jews?
children-batch4:mtc:1949.answer: That the Jews be destroyed on one day

That the Jews rule over every province

children-batch4:mtc:195.question: What did the young women do during the twelve months before meeting King Xerxes?
children-batch4:mtc:195.answer: Got beauty treatments with oil and perfume
wrong: Learned how to fight with sharp swords
Worked out in the farm fields
Built a new wall for the city

children-batch4:mtc:1951.question: In Esther's time, what could happen to anyone who went in to King Xerxes in the inner court without being called?
children-batch4:mtc:1951.answer: They could be put to death
wrong: They would get a gold crown

children-batch4:mtc:982.question: After Jesus rose from the dead, for how many days did He show Himself to the apostles?
children-batch4:mtc:982.why: Named who Jesus showed Himself to; matched the verse's 'forty days'

children-batch4:mtc:983.question: Why did Jesus tell the apostles to wait for the Holy Spirit?
children-batch4:mtc:983.answer: So they would get power to tell about Him

So they could become rich kings

children-batch4:mtc:984.question: John the Baptist said that Someone coming after him would baptize with the Holy Spirit. Who was he talking about?
children-batch4:mtc:984.why: Named John the Baptist; made it a plain question

children-batch4:mtc:985.question: When John the Baptist saw Jesus coming toward him, what did he call Jesus?
children-batch4:mtc:985.why: Named John the Baptist and when he said it

children-batch4:mtc:986.question: The Bible tells us how people are saved and forgiven. How are we saved?
children-batch4:mtc:986.why: Changed the yes-or-no question into one about how we are saved, using a verse that teaches it

children-batch4:mtc:987.question: When people were baptized by John, what did it show?
children-batch4:mtc:987.answer: They were turning away from their sins

children-batch4:mtc:987.why: Changed the 'main point' prompt into a question about John's baptism

children-batch4:mtc:989.dropped: The printed answer is a teaching these verses do not give, and Christians explain it in different ways. q6 already covers what John's baptism showed.

children-batch4:mtc:99.question: When believers pray about everything, what will guard their hearts and minds?
children-batch4:mtc:99.why: Matched the verse: peace guards hearts and minds

children-batch4:mtc:990.question: When Jesus came up out of the water, the Spirit of God came down like what kind of bird?
children-batch4:mtc:990.why: Fixed to match the verse: the Spirit came down like a dove, and Jesus saw it

children-batch4:mtc:991.question: At Jesus' baptism, how do we see the Father, the Son, and the Holy Spirit?
children-batch4:mtc:991.answer: Jesus is baptized, the Spirit comes like a dove, the Father speaks

Jesus is baptized, the Spirit comes as wind, John speaks
Jesus is baptized, the Spirit stays away, thunder sounds

children-batch4:mtc:992.question: Jesus was tempted in every way, just as we are. What does the Bible say about Him?
children-batch4:mtc:992.answer: He was tempted but never sinned

children-batch4:mtc:993.question: When Jesus saw James and his brother John, what were they doing?
children-batch4:mtc:993.answer: Mending their nets in a boat

children-batch4:mtc:994.question: Jesus called Levi the tax collector and ate with sinners. Why does Jesus call sinners to come to Him?
children-batch4:mtc:994.why: Tied it to the story of Levi; gave a verse that names God's love

children-batch4:mtc:995.question: In John 12, a voice came from heaven. At what other time did a voice from heaven speak about Jesus?
wrong: When Jesus turned water into wine

children-batch4:mtc:995.why: Changed the open discussion prompt into a question with one answer

children-batch4:mtc:996.question: The people in Capernaum were amazed at Jesus' teaching and power. Who is Jesus?
children-batch4:mtc:996.why: Tied it to the story so it stands on its own; kept the teaching that Jesus is the Son of God

children-batch4:mtc:997.question: What is the Bible?
wrong: A book of rules people made up
children-batch4:mtc:997.why: Verses given don't answer it; took the answer from 2 Timothy 3:16; added choices
children-batch4:mtc:997.fixed: The wrong choice 'A book written by kings' is partly true, since kings like David and Solomon wrote parts of the Bible. It is replaced with a choice that is clearly wrong.

children-batch4:mtc:998.question: Why is the cross important for Christians?
children-batch4:mtc:998.answer: Jesus died on it for our sins
wrong: Jesus built it as a carpenter
children-batch4:mtc:998.why: Removed 'Does anyone know'; answer now says why the cross matters, from 1 Corinthians 15:3

children-batch4:mtc:999.question: What does the Bible say about Jesus and sin?
wrong: Jesus sinned when He was angry
children-batch4:mtc:999.why: Changed the yes-or-no question to one with four choices, using 1 Peter 2:22

children-batch4:uw:10.answer: To rule over the earth and its creatures

children-batch4:uw:10.why: Simpler wording; removed 'care for them', which these verses do not say

children-batch4:uw:100.question: What did Jacob send to Esau to calm Esau's anger?
children-batch4:uw:100.answer: Herds of animals as a gift
