A new tent and fine robes

children-batch4:uw:101.question: What did Esau do when he met Jacob again?
children-batch4:uw:101.answer: Ran to hug and kiss him
wrong: Sent his men to chase him
children-batch4:uw:101.why: Yes-or-no question made into four choices

children-batch4:uw:102.question: After Jacob met Esau again, he came to a city in Canaan. He camped beside it and bought land there. Which city was it?
wrong: A city by the Red Sea
children-batch4:uw:102.why: Simpler words; added Shechem from the verse
children-batch4:uw:102.fixed: Genesis 33:17 says Jacob first went to Succoth and built a house there, so 'went to live' near Shechem is not quite right. The fixed question asks about the city where he camped and bought land.

children-batch4:uw:103.question: God had made promises to Abraham and Isaac. Who did God give those same promises to next?
children-batch4:uw:103.why: Simpler words; matched the verses, where God gives Jacob the promise

children-batch4:uw:104.question: Why did Joseph's brothers hate him?
children-batch4:uw:104.answer: Their father loved him best, and his dreams
wrong: Joseph broke all of their tools and carts
Joseph ate all of their food at night
Joseph was the oldest and the strongest

children-batch4:uw:105.question: What wrong thing did Joseph's brothers do to him?
children-batch4:uw:105.answer: Sold him to traders for silver
wrong: Sent him home to their father
Gave him a new colorful robe
Made him king over all of them

children-batch4:uw:106.question: How did Joseph's brothers make their father Jacob think Joseph was gone?
children-batch4:uw:106.answer: Sent him Joseph's robe so he thought an animal got Joseph
wrong: Said Joseph ran away to the sea
Said Joseph went to live with Esau
Said Joseph got lost in the desert
children-batch4:uw:106.why: Told more gently; blood is not the point of the question

children-batch4:uw:107.question: What did the LORD do for Joseph in Egypt, even in prison?
children-batch4:uw:107.answer: He was with Joseph and blessed him
wrong: He forgot all about poor Joseph
He sent Joseph right back home
He made Joseph run far away
children-batch4:uw:107.why: Yes-or-no question made into four choices

children-batch4:uw:108.question: Why was Joseph put in prison in Egypt?
children-batch4:uw:108.answer: His master's wife lied about him
wrong: He stole money from his master
He ran away from his work
children-batch4:uw:108.why: Grown-up details removed; told gently; reference widened to include the lie and prison

children-batch4:uw:109.question: What did God help Joseph to do?

children-batch4:uw:11.question: What did God use to make the first man?
children-batch4:uw:11.why: Simpler wording; 'soil' changed to BSB 'dust of the ground'

children-batch4:uw:110.question: What did Pharaoh's dream mean?
children-batch4:uw:110.answer: Seven full years, then seven hungry years
wrong: Seven years of rain, then a great flood
Seven years of war with a faraway land
Pharaoh would soon have seven strong sons

children-batch4:uw:111.question: How did Pharaoh reward Joseph for telling what Pharaoh's dream meant?
children-batch4:uw:111.answer: He put Joseph over all of Egypt
wrong: He sent Joseph back to the prison
He gave Joseph a small farm
He sent Joseph home to Canaan
children-batch4:uw:111.fixed: In the question, "his dream" could mean Joseph's own dreams. The dream Joseph explained was Pharaoh's, so the question should say so.

children-batch4:uw:112.question: How did Joseph get ready for the seven years of famine?
children-batch4:uw:112.answer: He stored up grain in the cities
wrong: He sent everyone away from Egypt
He planted trees by the river
He asked his brothers to send food
children-batch4:uw:112.why: Took out the selling of food, which these verses do not mention; kept to the storing of grain.

children-batch4:uw:113.question: Why did Joseph's brothers come to Egypt?
children-batch4:uw:113.answer: To buy grain during the famine
wrong: To look for their lost sheep
To fight a war against Egypt
children-batch4:uw:113.why: Used 'grain' as the BSB does and shortened the answer.

children-batch4:uw:114.question: What did Joseph say to his brothers the first time they came to Egypt to buy food?
wrong: "Go home, there is no food here!"
children-batch4:uw:114.why: The verses never say why Joseph tested his brothers, so the question now asks what Joseph said to them.
children-batch4:uw:114.fixed: The brothers came to buy food a second time too, and on that trip Joseph did say "I am Joseph, your brother" (Genesis 45:4). So that wrong choice could also be right. The question needs to say this was their first trip.

children-batch4:uw:115.question: Joseph's brothers sold him as a slave. What good did God bring out of it?
children-batch4:uw:115.answer: God used Joseph to save many lives
wrong: Joseph became rich and forgot his family
Joseph's brothers became kings of Egypt
God stopped the famine from coming
children-batch4:uw:115.why: Put it in a child's words and used the BSB's 'preserve the lives of many people'.

children-batch4:uw:116.question: What did Jacob do after he found out that his son Joseph was alive?
children-batch4:uw:116.answer: He moved his whole family to Egypt
wrong: He stayed in Canaan and waited
He sent Benjamin away to Midian
He built a city in the desert
children-batch4:uw:116.why: Changed 'Joseph' to 'his son Joseph' so the question stands on its own.

children-batch4:uw:117.question: Before Jacob died, whom did he bless?
children-batch4:uw:117.why: These verses do not say who received Abraham's promises, so the question now asks whom Jacob blessed before he died.
children-batch4:uw:117.fixed: Jacob really did bless Pharaoh before he died (Genesis 47:7, 10), so the wrong choice "Pharaoh and his servants" is partly true. It is swapped for a choice that is plainly wrong.

children-batch4:uw:118.question: What did the families of Jacob's twelve sons become?
children-batch4:uw:118.why: Changed the reference to Genesis 49:28, which names the twelve tribes.

children-batch4:uw:119.why: In the verses it is the new king who speaks, so the question now asks about him.

wrong: Sent them all home to Canaan

Made them rich with lots of gold

children-batch4:uw:121.answer: They feared God and let the boys live
wrong: They did just what Pharaoh told them
They ran away to the land of Midian
They went and hid in Pharaoh's palace
children-batch4:uw:121.why: The printed answer comes from a verse not given and puts the harm to babies at the centre, so the question now asks about the brave midwives.

children-batch4:uw:122.question: What happened to baby Moses in the basket by the river?
children-batch4:uw:122.answer: Pharaoh's daughter found him and made him her son
wrong: The basket floated far away out to the sea
Shepherds found him and took him away to Midian
His father picked him up and carried him to Canaan
children-batch4:uw:122.why: Said who the baby was and widened the reference to cover his adoption and his name.

children-batch4:uw:123.question: When Moses grew up, what did he see when he went out to his own people?
children-batch4:uw:123.why: The killing was the point of the question; it now asks gently about Moses going out to see his people.

children-batch4:uw:124.question: Why did Moses have to run away from Egypt?
children-batch4:uw:124.answer: Pharaoh heard what he did and wanted to kill him
wrong: A great famine came to the whole land of Egypt

Pharaoh's daughter got angry and sent him away
children-batch4:uw:124.why: Put the answer gently and in short, plain words.

children-batch4:uw:125.question: Where did Moses go to get away from Pharaoh?
children-batch4:uw:125.why: Changed the answer to Midian, the place the BSB names.

children-batch4:uw:126.answer: A bush on fire that did not burn up

A big rock that gave out cool water

wrong: A dry, empty land with no water at all

Right back to the land of Egypt again

children-batch4:uw:131.question: When Moses asked God's name, what name did God say would be His name forever?

children-batch4:uw:145.question: Where did God tell the Israelites to put the blood of the Passover lamb?

children-batch4:uw:146.question: What kind of bread did God tell the Israelites to eat with the roasted lamb?
children-batch4:uw:146.why: Made the words simpler. Kept the answer.

children-batch4:uw:147.question: When the Israelites ate the Passover meal, dressed with sandals on and staff in hand, what were they ready to do?

children-batch4:uw:149.question: On the night of the Passover, what happened to the firstborn son in each Egyptian home?

children-batch4:uw:15.answer: The tree of knowing good and evil

children-batch4:uw:151.question: What did Pharaoh tell Moses and Aaron after the last plague?

children-batch4:uw:152.question: What did the Egyptians give the Israelites as they left Egypt?

children-batch4:uw:153.question: Besides the Israelites, who else went with them out of Egypt?

children-batch4:uw:154.question: How did God lead the Israelites on their way out of Egypt?
children-batch4:uw:154.answer: A pillar of cloud and of fire
wrong: A bright star shining in the sky
A map that Pharaoh gave them
A flock of birds flying ahead

children-batch4:uw:155.question: Why did God harden Pharaoh's heart so that he chased the Israelites?
children-batch4:uw:155.answer: So the Egyptians would know He is the LORD
wrong: So Pharaoh could win the battle

children-batch4:uw:155.why: Changed the answer to match the BSB: so the Egyptians would know He is the LORD.

children-batch4:uw:156.question: What did the Israelites say to Moses when they saw Pharaoh's army coming after them?
children-batch4:uw:156.answer: Why did you bring us out of Egypt?
wrong: We are not afraid at all!

children-batch4:uw:157.question: What did Moses tell the scared Israelites at the Red Sea?

Go and hide in the hills until Pharaoh leaves.

children-batch4:uw:158.question: How did God keep the Egyptians away from the Israelites all night at the Red Sea?

wrong: A tall wall of stones stood between them.

The Egyptian soldiers all fell asleep.

children-batch4:uw:159.question: What did God tell Moses to do so the Israelites could get through the Red Sea?
children-batch4:uw:159.answer: Lift his staff and stretch his hand over the sea.
wrong: Throw a big stone into the middle of the sea.
Build a big boat for all of the people.
Wait on a hill until the sea dried up.

children-batch4:uw:16.question: What did God say would happen if Adam ate from the tree of the knowledge of good and evil?

children-batch4:uw:160.question: How did the Israelites get across the Red Sea?
children-batch4:uw:160.answer: They walked through on dry ground.

children-batch4:uw:160.why: Named the Red Sea; simpler wording

children-batch4:uw:161.question: What did God do to the Egyptians as they chased the Israelites into the sea?
children-batch4:uw:161.answer: Mixed them up and made their chariot wheels wobble.

Gave them a strong bridge to cross the sea.
Sent them plenty of food and fresh water.

children-batch4:uw:162.question: What happened to Pharaoh's army when Moses stretched out his hand over the sea again?
children-batch4:uw:162.answer: The waters came back and covered them.
wrong: The army walked safely back to Egypt.
The sea turned into soft, dry sand.
The army climbed into boats and escaped.
children-batch4:uw:162.why: Asked gently what happened rather than about destroying; uses the BSB's words

children-batch4:uw:163.question: What did the Israelites do when they saw God's great power over the Egyptians?
children-batch4:uw:163.answer: They feared the LORD and believed in Him.

children-batch4:uw:164.question: Why did Moses and the Israelites sing a song to the LORD after crossing the Red Sea?
children-batch4:uw:164.answer: God had saved them from Pharaoh's army.

children-batch4:uw:165.question: What did God tell the Israelites to do every year to remember the day He brought them out of Egypt?
children-batch4:uw:165.answer: Celebrate the Passover as a feast to the LORD.
wrong: Build a tall tower of stones in the desert.
